uz.explanation: Biror narsaning ichiga harakat → into.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Put the bottle ___ the shelf."
questions.explanation: Movement to a surface → onto.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Put the bottle ___ the shelf."
ru.explanation: Движение на поверхность → onto.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Put the bottle ___ the shelf."
uz.explanation: Sirt ustiga harakat → onto.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Take the probe ___ the liquid."
questions.explanation: Movement from the inside → out of.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Take the probe ___ the liquid."
ru.explanation: Движение изнутри наружу → out of.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Take the probe ___ the liquid."
uz.explanation: Ichdan tashqariga harakat → out of.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Take the pan ___ the heat."
questions.explanation: Leaving a surface → off.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Take the pan ___ the heat."
ru.explanation: Уход с поверхности → off.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Take the pan ___ the heat."
uz.explanation: Sirtdan olib ketish → off.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Light does not need to travel ___ a medium."
questions.explanation: through = from one side to the other INSIDE a 3-D medium; across = on a 2-D surface.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Light does not need to travel ___ a medium."
ru.explanation: through = с одной стороны на другую ВНУТРИ трёхмерной среды; across = по двумерной поверхности.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Light does not need to travel ___ a medium."
uz.explanation: through = uch oʻlchamli muhit ICHIDA bir tomondan ikkinchisiga; across = ikki oʻlchamli sirt boʻylab.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Waves move ___ the stadium." (from one side to the other on a surface)
questions.explanation: across = on a surface; through = inside a space.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Waves move ___ the stadium." (с одной стороны на другую по поверхности)
ru.explanation: across = по поверхности; through = внутри пространства.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Waves move ___ the stadium." (sirt boʻylab bir tomondan ikkinchisiga)
uz.explanation: across = sirt boʻylab; through = makon ichidan.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "Walk ___ the corridor to the lab."
questions.explanation: along = following a line.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "Walk ___ the corridor to the lab."
ru.explanation: along = вдоль линии.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "Walk ___ the corridor to the lab."
uz.explanation: along = chiziq boʻylab.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "The storm is moving ___ the coast." (direction, not necessarily arrival)
questions.explanation: towards = direction without necessarily arriving; to = arrival.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "The storm is moving ___ the coast." (направление, необязательно прибытие)
ru.explanation: towards = направление без обязательного прибытия; to = прибытие.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "The storm is moving ___ the coast." (yoʻnalish, yetib borish shart emas)
uz.explanation: towards = yetib borish shartsiz yoʻnalish; to = yetib borish.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement: "The wave moves ___ its starting point."
questions.explanation: away from = movement to a distance.

ru.text: Предлоги движения: "The wave moves ___ its starting point."
ru.explanation: away from = отдаление (движение на расстояние).

uz.text: Harakat predloglari: "The wave moves ___ its starting point."
uz.explanation: away from = uzoqlashish harakati.

questions.text: Prepositions of movement (time): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — choose the correct series.
questions.explanation: on + days, at + clock times, in + months/seasons/years.

ru.text: Предлоги движения (время): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — выберите правильную серию.
ru.explanation: on + дни, at + время на часах, in + месяцы/сезоны/годы.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari (vaqt): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: on + kunlar, at + soat vaqtlari, in + oylar/mavsumlar/yillar.

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "Stereotyping can result ___ prejudice and discrimination."
questions.explanation: result in = cause (a result).

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "Stereotyping can result ___ prejudice and discrimination."
ru.explanation: result in = приводить к (иметь результатом).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "Stereotyping can result ___ prejudice and discrimination."
uz.explanation: result in = natija boʻlmoq (sabab boʻlmoq).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "Generalizations are based ___ facts and evidence."
questions.explanation: based on facts.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "Generalizations are based ___ facts and evidence."
ru.explanation: based on facts (основано на фактах).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "Generalizations are based ___ facts and evidence."
uz.explanation: based on facts (faktlarga asoslangan).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "The results from the repeat experiment must tally ___ the first ones."
questions.explanation: tally with = match.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "The results from the repeat experiment must tally ___ the first ones."
ru.explanation: tally with = совпадать.

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "The results from the repeat experiment must tally ___ the first ones."
uz.explanation: tally with = mos kelmoq.

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "It all depends ___ whether or not they have any vacancies."
questions.explanation: depend on.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "It all depends ___ whether or not they have any vacancies."
ru.explanation: depend on (зависеть от).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "It all depends ___ whether or not they have any vacancies."
uz.explanation: depend on (bogʻliq boʻlmoq).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
questions.explanation: be used for + -ing.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
ru.explanation: be used for + -ing (использоваться для чего-либо).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
uz.explanation: be used for + -ing (biror narsa uchun ishlatilmoq).

questions.text: Dependent prepositions: "She is ___ charge ___ that project." — choose the correct pair.
questions.explanation: be in charge of something.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "She is ___ charge ___ that project." — выберите правильную пару.
ru.explanation: be in charge of something (отвечать за что-либо).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "She is ___ charge ___ that project." — toʻgʻri juftlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: be in charge of something (biror narsaga masʼul boʻlmoq).

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why did the king have to give the pilgrim so much rice?
questions.optionA: Because of the doubling agreement — the amount doubled on every square, reaching exponential growth
questions.optionB: Because the pilgrim was very hungry
questions.optionC: Because rice was very cheap at the time
questions.optionD: Because the king wanted to fill the palace
questions.explanation: 1 grain, then double on every square: by the 64th square the total exceeded 18 × 10^18 grains.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему королю пришлось отдать паломнику так много риса?
ru.explanation: 1 зерно, затем удвоение на каждой клетке: к 64-й клетке общее количество превысило 18 × 10^18 зёрен.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Shoh nima uchun ziyoratchiga bunday koʻp guruch berishga majbur boʻldi?
uz.explanation: 1 don, soʻngra har bir katakda ikki barobar: 64-katakkacha boʻlganda jami 18 × 10^18 donadan oshib ketdi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": What is Moore's Law?
questions.optionA: Memory grows by 424 kilobytes every year
questions.optionC: Computer speed increases by 400,000 instructions per second
questions.optionD: The power of computer microchips doubles every 18 months
questions.explanation: Moore's Law: microchip power doubles every 18 months.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Что такое закон Мура?
ru.explanation: Закон Мура: мощность микрочипов удваивается каждые 18 месяцев.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Mur qonuni nima?
uz.explanation: Mur qonuni: mikrochipning quvvati har 18 oyda ikki barobar oshadi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Which has more memory — the first space shuttle computer or a smartphone?
questions.optionD: The space shuttle — 424 kilobytes is more
questions.explanation: The shuttle had 424 KB; a smartphone has over 33,000,000 times more.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": У чего больше памяти — у компьютера первого шаттла или у смартфона?
ru.explanation: У шаттла было 424 KB; у смартфона — более чем в 33,000,000 раз больше.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Qaysi birida xotira koʻp — birinchi kosmik shattl kompyuterida yoki smartfonda?
uz.explanation: Shattlda 424 KB bor edi; smartfonda esa 33,000,000 martadan koʻproq.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is it now quicker to analyse human genes?
questions.optionA: Because there are fewer genes now
questions.optionB: Because the Human Genome Project never finished
questions.optionC: Because of faster computers — what took 13 years now takes a week
questions.explanation: The Human Genome Project took 13 years (1990-2003); faster computers now do it in a week.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему теперь анализ человеческих генов проходит быстрее?
ru.explanation: Проект «Геном человека» занял 13 лет (1990-2003); теперь более быстрые компьютеры делают это за неделю.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun endi inson genlarini tahlil qilish tezroq?
uz.explanation: Inson genomi loyihasi 13 yil vaqt oldi (1990-2003); endi tezkor kompyuterlar buni bir haftada bajaradi.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": How many people now go to university in the UK and in Finland?
questions.explanation: About 40% in the UK (vs ~5% in the 1960s) and 80% in Finland.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Сколько людей теперь учится в университетах в Великобритании и в Финляндии?
ru.explanation: Около 40% в Великобритании (против ~5% в 1960-е годы) и 80% в Финляндии.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Endi Buyuk Britaniya va Finlyandiyada necha kishi universitetda oʻqiydi?
uz.explanation: Buyuk Britaniyada taxminan 40% (1960-yillardagi ~5% ga qarshi), Finlyandiyada 80%.

questions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is research now published more quickly?
questions.optionA: More postgraduate students → more competition for funding → pressure to publish quickly
questions.explanation: The cause-effect chain: more students → competition for funding → as a result, pressure to publish quickly.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему исследования теперь публикуются быстрее?
ru.explanation: Цепочка причина–следствие: больше студентов → конкуренция за финансирование → в результате, давление в пользу быстрой публикации.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun tadqiqotlar endi tezroq nashr etiladi?
uz.explanation: Sabab–natija zanjiri: koʻproq talabalar → mablagʻ uchun raqobat → natijada tez nashr etish bosimi.

questions.text: Cause–effect connectors: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — choose the connector + noun.
questions.explanation: because of + noun (because needs a clause).

ru.text: Коннекторы причины–следствия: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — выберите коннектор + существительное.
ru.explanation: because of + существительное (because требует придаточного предложения).

uz.text: Sabab–natija bogʻlovchilari: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — bogʻlovchi + ot juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: because of + ot (because esa qoʻshma gap talab qiladi).

questions.text: Cause–effect: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
questions.explanation: As a result — the fixed connector.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
ru.explanation: As a result — устойчивый коннектор.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "This has created greater competition. ___, there is more pressure on scientists."
uz.explanation: As a result — oʻzgarmas bogʻlovchi.

questions.text: Cause–effect: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
questions.explanation: lead to = cause.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
ru.explanation: lead to = приводить к.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "This new research then ___ other new discoveries."
uz.explanation: lead to = olib boradi (sabab boʻladi).

questions.text: Cause–effect: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — choose the connector meaning "as a result".
questions.explanation: as a consequence = as a result.

ru.text: Причина–следствие: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — выберите коннектор со значением «as a result».
ru.explanation: as a consequence = as a result.

uz.text: Sabab–natija: "___, new technologies are developed more rapidly." — «as a result» maʼnosidagi bogʻlovchini tanlang.
uz.explanation: as a consequence = as a result (natijada).

questions.text: Verbs of change: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (trend verb from the text)
questions.explanation: double = become twice as much.

ru.text: Глаголы изменения: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (глагол тренда из текста)
ru.explanation: double = становиться вдвое больше.

uz.text: Oʻzgarish feʼllari: "The power of microchips ___ every 18 months." (matndagi trend feʼli)
uz.explanation: double = ikki barobar boʻlmoq.

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — choose the correct verb + preposition.
questions.explanation: rise by + amount (rose by 75%).

ru.text: Лексика трендов: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — выберите правильную пару «глагол + предлог».
ru.explanation: rise by + величина (rose by 75%).

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: "Student numbers ___ by 75% between 2000 and 2010." — toʻgʻri «feʼl + predlog» juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: rise by + miqdor (rose by 75%).

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — which verb is the MOST dramatic (worksheet tip)?
questions.explanation: Be dramatic: rocketed tells the audience more than increased.

ru.text: Лексика трендов: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — какой глагол САМЫЙ драматичный (совет из рабочего листа)?
ru.explanation: Будьте драматичны: rocketed сообщает аудитории больше, чем increased.

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: "Sales ___ in the third quarter" — qaysi feʼl ENG dramatik (varaqdagi maslahat)?
uz.explanation: Dramatik boʻling: rocketed tinglovchiga increased dan koʻproq maʼlumot beradi.

questions.text: Trend vocabulary: Which pair describes DOWNWARD movement most dramatically?
questions.explanation: slump and plummet are dramatic downward verbs; jump/take off = up; hold steady/settle = stability.

ru.text: Лексика трендов: Какая пара наиболее драматично описывает движение ВНИЗ?
ru.explanation: slump и plummet — драматичные глаголы движения вниз; jump/take off = вверх; hold steady/settle = стабильность.

uz.text: Trend lugʻati: Qaysi juftlik PASTGA harakatni eng dramatik tasvirlaydi?
uz.explanation: slump va plummet — pastga harakatning dramatik feʼllari; jump/take off = yuqoriga; hold steady/settle = barqarorlik.

questions.text: Quantifying change: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — choose the correct series.
questions.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (also: from 2000 to 2010).

ru.text: Количественная оценка изменений: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — выберите правильную серию.
ru.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (также: from 2000 to 2010).

uz.text: Oʻzgarishni miqdoriy ifodalash: "…the number of students studying abroad rose ___ 75% ___ 2000 ___ 2010." — toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: rose by 75% between 2000 and 2010 (yoki: from 2000 to 2010).

questions.text: Fluctuation: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — choose the verb.
questions.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y.

ru.text: Колебание: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y (колебаться между X и Y).

uz.text: Tebranish: "The exchange rate ___ between 0.33% and 4%." — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: fluctuate between X and Y (X va Y orasida tebranmoq).

questions.text: Test 1 format: What is Test 1?
questions.optionC: A paper-based writing task, 1 hour, worth 10% of the course grade
questions.explanation: Test 1: paper-based writing task, 1 hour, 10% of the grade, covering Weeks 1-3.

ru.text: Формат Test 1: Что такое Test 1?
ru.explanation: Test 1: письменное задание на бумаге, 1 час, 10% итоговой оценки, охватывает недели 1-3.

uz.text: Test 1 formati: Test 1 nima?
uz.explanation: Test 1: qogʻoz asosidagi yozma topshiriq, 1 soat, bahoning 10%, 1-3 haftalarni qamrab oladi.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing a tense, what is the FIRST question to ask?
questions.optionA: Is the word long or short?
questions.optionB: Is it routine/permanent (PS), now/temporary (PC), or a stative meaning (PS)?
questions.optionC: Is the sentence long or short?
questions.optionD: Is the subject human or not?
questions.explanation: Routine/permanent → present simple; now/temporary → present continuous; stative → present simple.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Выбирая глагольное время, какой вопрос задаёте ПЕРВЫМ?
ru.explanation: Регулярное/постоянное → present simple; сейчас/временное → present continuous; состояние → present simple.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Zamon tanlashda BIRINCHI qanday savol beriladi?
uz.explanation: Muntazam/doimiy → present simple; hozir/vaqtincha → present continuous; holat → present simple.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing an article, what should you ask?
questions.optionB: Always use the with singular nouns
questions.optionC: Articles are optional in writing tasks
questions.optionD: First mention or general → a/an; already known, unique or superlative → the; general plural/uncountable → zero
questions.explanation: The article decision tree from Weeks 2.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Выбирая артикль, о чём следует спросить себя?
ru.explanation: Дерево решений для артикля из недели 2.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Artikel tanlashda nimadan soʻrash kerak?
uz.explanation: 2-haftadagi artikel boʻyicha qarorlar daraxti.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: How much time should you leave for checking?
questions.explanation: Leave 5 minutes to check verbs and articles — most marks are lost there.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Сколько времени нужно оставить на проверку?
ru.explanation: Оставьте 5 минут на проверку глаголов и артиклей — именно там теряется больше всего баллов.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Tekshirish uchun qancha vaqt qoldirish kerak?
uz.explanation: Feʼllar va artikelni tekshirish uchun 5 daqiqa qoldiring — aynan shu yerda koʻp ball yoʻqoladi.

questions.text: Test 1 checklist: What sentence type does the answer key convention reward?
questions.optionA: Long paragraphs without the target grammar
questions.optionC: Complete sentences with the justified grammatical form
questions.explanation: Write complete sentences, not notes — a full sentence with the justified form.

ru.text: Чек-лист Test 1: Какой тип предложения поощряется конвенцией ключа ответов?
ru.explanation: Пишите полные предложения, а не заметки — полное предложение с обоснованной формой.

uz.text: Test 1 tekshiruv roʻyxati: Javoblar kaliti anʼanasi qanday gap turini ragʻbatlantiradi?
uz.explanation: Toʻliq gaplar yozing, qisqa yozuvlar emas — asoslangan shakl bilan toʻliq gap.

shuffledQuestions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you from?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The verb be with you → are: "Where are you from?" (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Откуда ты ___?»
ru.explanation: Глагол be с you → are: “Where are you from?” (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerdan ___?»
uz.explanation: you bilan be feʼli → are: “Where are you from?” (berilgan savol).

shuffledQuestions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you born?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: "Where were you born?" — passive past of be with you → were (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Где ты ___?»
ru.explanation: “Where were you born?” — страдательный залог в прошедшем времени от be с you → were (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerda ___?»
uz.explanation: “Where were you born?” — be feʼlining you bilan oʻtgan zamondagi majhul shakli → were (berilgan savol).

shuffledQuestions.text: What languages do you ___?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: speak a language; "say/tell" take different objects, "talk" needs "about/of".

ru.text: Какими языками ты ___?
ru.explanation: speak a language (говорить на языке); “say/tell” требуют других дополнений, “talk” требует “about/of”.

uz.text: Sen qaysi tillarda ___?
uz.explanation: speak a language (til gapirish); “say/tell” boshqa toʻldiruvchilar bilan ishlatiladi, “talk” uchun esa “about/of” kerak.

shuffledQuestions.text: Where do you ___? (= where are you a student / do you work?)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: live (also possible: study). "Where do you live?" is the standard question.

ru.text: Где ты ___? (= где ты учишься / работаешь?)
ru.explanation: Ключ: live (возможен также: study). “Where do you live?” — стандартный вопрос.

uz.text: Sen qayerda ___? (= qayerda oʻqiysan yoki ishlaysan?)
uz.explanation: Kalit: live (yana mumkin: study). “Where do you live?” — standart savol.

shuffledQuestions.text: Do you ___ any brothers or sisters?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Do + you + infinitive have: "Do you have any brothers or sisters?"

ru.text: У тебя ___ братья или сёстры?
ru.explanation: Do + you + инфинитив have: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?”

uz.text: Senda aka-uka yoki opa-singillar ___?
uz.explanation: Do + you + have feʼlining asosiy shakli: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?”

shuffledQuestions.text: Do you ___ any pets?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: have — "Do you have any pets?" (present simple question with do).

ru.text: У тебя ___ домашние животные?
ru.explanation: Ключ: have — “Do you have any pets?” (вопрос в present simple с do).

uz.text: Senda uy hayvonlari ___?
uz.explanation: Kalit: have — “Do you have any pets?” (do bilan present simple savoli).

shuffledQuestions.text: What do you ___? (= what is your job or study?)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The fixed question "What do you do?" asks about job/study.

ru.text: Чем ты ___? (= какая у тебя работа или учёба?)
ru.explanation: Устойчивый вопрос “What do you do?” спрашивает о работе/учёбе.

uz.text: Sen nima ___? (= ishing yoki oʻqishing nima?)

shuffledQuestions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:01–0:27): What did people tell Olivia about French people — and what did she discover?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: People said France was just like her home country.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: People warned her the French were rude and unfriendly, but she found them kind and welcoming — the stereotype was wrong.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: People said the French were very friendly, but she found them rude.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: People told her nothing about the French before her trip.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Before the trip people warned her; on arrival she discovered the opposite — a classic wrong stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Что люди рассказывали Olivia о французах — и что она обнаружила?

shuffledQuestions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:57–1:09): What happened after Olivia won a point in a sport?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: A boy congratulated her and asked her to join the team.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Her coach said she should practise more.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: A boy told her "you play like a girl" — meant as an insult, and it made her feel hurt, small and angry.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The comment "you play like a girl" treats being a girl as something bad — a gender stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:57–1:09): Что случилось после того, как Olivia выиграла очко в спорте?

uz.explanation: “you play like a girl” degan gap qiz boʻlishni yomon narsa kabi koʻrsatadi — gender stereotipi.

shuffledQuestions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (2:22): Which two phrases does Olivia mention as harmful?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: "you play like a girl" and "that's not very ladylike"
shuffledQuestions.optionB: "you are so tall" and "you are so kind"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Both phrases box children (especially girls) into gender stereotypes.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (2:22): Какие две фразы Olivia называет вредными?
ru.explanation: Обе фразы загоняют детей (особенно девочек) в гендерные стереотипы.

shuffledQuestions.optionC: Call out stereotypes; check your own assumptions; be the example.
