uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "I have two or three times a day a cup of coffee."
uz.explanation: Takrorlik iborasi gap oxiriga qoʻyiladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "They don't play often board games."
shuffledQuestions.optionA: They often don't play board games.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: They don't play board games often play.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: They don't often play board games.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: They often play don't board games.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Adverb after don't, before the main verb.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "They don't play often board games."
ru.explanation: Наречие после don't, перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "They don't play often board games."
uz.explanation: Ravish don't dan keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "Does usually she take public transport?"
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Does usually takes she public transport?
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Does she take usually public transport?
shuffledQuestions.optionC: Usually does she take public transport?
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Does she usually take public transport?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Adverb after the subject (she), before the main verb.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "Does usually she take public transport?"
ru.explanation: Наречие после подлежащего (she), перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "Does usually she take public transport?"
uz.explanation: Ravish egadan (she) keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.3 (My day): "I ___ at about 7.30 a.m. and get ready for work." (frequency word + verb)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: usually + get up — adverb before the main verb.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3 (Мой день): "I ___ at about 7.30 a.m. and get ready for work." (наречие частотности + глагол)
ru.explanation: Ключ: usually + get up — наречие перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq (Mening kunim): "I ___ at about 7.30 a.m. and get ready for work." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: usually + get up — ravish asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I ___ breakfast because I don't feel hungry in the mornings." (frequency word + verb)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: never + have — no breakfast.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3: "I ___ breakfast because I don't feel hungry in the mornings." (наречие частотности + глагол)
ru.explanation: Ключ: never + have — без завтрака.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I ___ breakfast because I don't feel hungry in the mornings." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: never + have — nonushtasiz.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I ___ my friend for lunch — normally two or three times a week." (frequency word + verb)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: often + meet (two or three times a week → often).

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3: "I ___ my friend for lunch — normally two or three times a week." (наречие частотности + глагол)
ru.explanation: Ключ: often + meet (два или три раза в неделю → often).

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I ___ my friend for lunch — normally two or three times a week." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: often + meet (haftada ikki-uch marta → often).

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I like to keep fit, so I ___ to the gym." (frequency word + verb)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: usually + go.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3: "I like to keep fit, so I ___ to the gym." (наречие частотности + глагол)
ru.explanation: Ключ: usually + go.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I like to keep fit, so I ___ to the gym." (takrorlik soʻzi + feʼl)
uz.explanation: Kalit: usually + go.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (verb + frequency phrase)
shuffledQuestions.optionA: eat; two or three times a month
shuffledQuestions.optionB: eat; two or three times a month ago
shuffledQuestions.optionD: make; two or three times a month
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: eat + two or three times a month; unused words: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (глагол + словосочетание частотности)
ru.explanation: Ключ: eat + два или три раза в месяц; неиспользованные слова: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (feʼl + takrorlik iborasi)
uz.explanation: Kalit: eat + oyda ikki-uch marta; ishlatilmagan soʻzlar: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I used to have ___ of different gadgets, but now I use my phone for almost everything."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: a lot (of different gadgets).

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I used to have ___ of different gadgets, but now I use my phone for almost everything."
ru.explanation: Ключ: a lot (of different gadgets).

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I used to have ___ of different gadgets, but now I use my phone for almost everything."
uz.explanation: Kalit: a lot (of different gadgets).

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I'd like to have a better computer, but I don't have ___ to buy one right now."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: enough money (enough + noun).

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I'd like to have a better computer, but I don't have ___ to buy one right now."
ru.explanation: Ключ: enough money (enough + существительное).

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I'd like to have a better computer, but I don't have ___ to buy one right now."
uz.explanation: Kalit: enough money (enough + ot).

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I spend ___ time online. I think I need to take a break."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: too much + uncountable (time) — Rule 13.

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I spend ___ time online. I think I need to take a break."
ru.explanation: too much + неисчисляемое (time) — Правило 13.

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I spend ___ time online. I think I need to take a break."
uz.explanation: too much + sanalmas ot (time) — 13-qoida.

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I have a lot of friends on social media, but only ___ of them are close friends."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: a couple (or a few) of them.

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I have a lot of friends on social media, but only ___ of them are close friends."
ru.explanation: Ключ: a couple (или a few) of them.

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I have a lot of friends on social media, but only ___ of them are close friends."
uz.explanation: Kalit: a couple (yoki a few) of them.

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I never watch TV or films on my phone, because the screen isn't ___."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: enough AFTER the adjective: big enough — Rule 14.

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I never watch TV or films on my phone, because the screen isn't ___."
ru.explanation: enough ПОСЛЕ прилагательного: big enough — Правило 14.

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I never watch TV or films on my phone, because the screen isn't ___."
uz.explanation: enough sifatdan KEYIN keladi: big enough — 14-qoida.

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I like Apple products, but I can't afford them — I think they're ___."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: too + adjective: too expensive.

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I like Apple products, but I can't afford them — I think they're ___."
ru.explanation: too + прилагательное: too expensive.

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I like Apple products, but I can't afford them — I think they're ___."
uz.explanation: too + sifat: too expensive.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "I just have to reply to ___ emails." (a few / a little)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: emails = countable plural → a few.

ru.text: Задание 1: "I just have to reply to ___ emails." (a few / a little)
ru.explanation: emails = исчисляемое во множественном числе → a few.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I just have to reply to ___ emails." (a few / a little)
uz.explanation: emails = sanaladigan koʻplik → a few.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "Do you spend ___ time on social media?" (much / many)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: time = uncountable, and it is a question → much.

ru.text: Задание 1: "Do you spend ___ time on social media?" (much / many)
ru.explanation: time = неисчисляемое, и это вопрос → much.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "Do you spend ___ time on social media?" (much / many)
uz.explanation: time = sanalmas, va bu soʻroq → much.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "My bedroom is a nice size. There's ___ for a desk." (enough room / plenty of room)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Both fit "a nice size": enough room = sufficient; plenty of room = more than enough (tick).

ru.text: Задание 1: "My bedroom is a nice size. There's ___ for a desk." (enough room / plenty of room)
ru.explanation: Оба подходят к «a nice size»: enough room = достаточно; plenty of room = более чем достаточно (верно).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "My bedroom is a nice size. There's ___ for a desk." (enough room / plenty of room)
uz.explanation: Ikkalasi ham «a nice size» ga mos: enough room = yetarli; plenty of room = yetaridan ham koʻproq (toʻgʻri).

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "I know very ___ people who speak two foreign languages." (few / little)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: people = countable → very few.

ru.text: Задание 1: "I know very ___ people who speak two foreign languages." (few / little)
ru.explanation: people = исчисляемое → very few.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I know very ___ people who speak two foreign languages." (few / little)
uz.explanation: people = sanaladi → very few.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a lot of / lots of are interchangeable with countable plurals (tick).

ru.text: Задание 1: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
ru.explanation: a lot of / lots of взаимозаменяемы перед исчисляемыми во множественном числе (верно).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
uz.explanation: a lot of / lots of sanaladigan koʻplik oldida almashinib ishlatiladi (toʻgʻri).

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "I have some cash on me, but not ___." (a lot / a lot of)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: After not, with no noun, use a lot (without of).

ru.text: Задание 1: "I have some cash on me, but not ___." (a lot / a lot of)
ru.explanation: После not, без существительного, используется a lot (без of).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I have some cash on me, but not ___." (a lot / a lot of)
uz.explanation: not dan keyin, ot boʻlmaganda, a lot (of siz) ishlatiladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "Their new TV is ___. It hardly fits in the living room." (too much big / too big)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: too + adjective; too much never precedes an adjective.

ru.text: Задание 1: "Their new TV is ___. It hardly fits in the living room." (too much big / too big)
ru.explanation: too + прилагательное; too much никогда не ставится перед прилагательным.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "Their new TV is ___. It hardly fits in the living room." (too much big / too big)
uz.explanation: too + sifat; too much sifatdan oldin hech qachon kelmaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "___ potatoes. I forgot to buy some." (There aren't any / There are no)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: aren't any (negative verb + any) and There are no (no + affirmative verb) are both correct (tick).

ru.text: Задание 1: "___ potatoes. I forgot to buy some." (There aren't any / There are no)
ru.explanation: aren't any (отрицательный глагол + any) и There are no (no + утвердительный глагол) — оба варианта верны (верно).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "___ potatoes. I forgot to buy some." (There aren't any / There are no)
uz.explanation: aren't any (inkor feʼl + any) va There are no (no + tasdiq feʼl) — ikkala variant ham toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "My niece isn't ___ to play with a games console." (old enough / enough old)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: enough follows the adjective — Rule 14.

ru.text: Задание 1: "My niece isn't ___ to play with a games console." (old enough / enough old)
ru.explanation: enough ставится после прилагательного — Правило 14.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "My niece isn't ___ to play with a games console." (old enough / enough old)
uz.explanation: enough sifatdan keyin keladi — 14-qoida.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "I don't have ___ close friends." (a lot of / many)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Both are possible (many slightly more formal) — tick.

ru.text: Задание 1: "I don't have ___ close friends." (a lot of / many)
ru.explanation: Возможны оба варианта (many чуть более формально) — верно.

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "I don't have ___ close friends." (a lot of / many)
uz.explanation: Ikkala variant ham mumkin (many biroz rasmiyroq) — toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "'How many presents did you get?' — 'A lot of!'" — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Wrong → "A lot of them!" only correct form
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a lot of must be followed by a noun; in short answers use a lot.

ru.text: Задание 2: "'How many presents did you get?' — 'A lot of!'" — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: после a lot of обязательно должно идти существительное; в кратких ответах используется a lot.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "'How many presents did you get?' — 'A lot of!'" — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: a lot of dan keyin ot kelishi shart; qisqa javoblarda a lot ishlatiladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "I buy fewer e-books than I used to because I prefer physical books." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: fewer + countable plural — correct.

ru.text: Задание 2: "I buy fewer e-books than I used to because I prefer physical books." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: fewer + исчисляемое во множественном числе — правильно.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "I buy fewer e-books than I used to because I prefer physical books." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: fewer + sanaladigan koʻplik — toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "There isn't no time to walk there. We'll have to get a taxi." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Wrong → "There isn't any time" / "There's no time"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Double negative impossible — Rule 15.

ru.text: Задание 2: "There isn't no time to walk there. We'll have to get a taxi." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: Двойное отрицание невозможно — Правило 15.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "There isn't no time to walk there. We'll have to get a taxi." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: Qoʻshaloq inkor mumkin emas — 15-qoida.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "Please turn that music down. It's too much loud!" — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: too + adjective: too loud.

ru.text: Задание 2: "Please turn that music down. It's too much loud!" — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: too + прилагательное: too loud.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "Please turn that music down. It's too much loud!" — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: too + sifat: too loud.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "There aren't many good programmes on TV tonight." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: aren't many + countable plural — correct.

ru.text: Задание 2: "There aren't many good programmes on TV tonight." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: aren't many + исчисляемое во множественном числе — правильно.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "There aren't many good programmes on TV tonight." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: aren't many + sanaladigan koʻplik — toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "My broadband isn't enough fast for me to download films easily." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: enough follows the adjective: fast enough.

ru.text: Задание 2: "My broadband isn't enough fast for me to download films easily." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: enough ставится после прилагательного: fast enough.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "My broadband isn't enough fast for me to download films easily." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: enough sifatdan keyin keladi: fast enough.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "I get too much emails at work. It takes me ages to read them all!" — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: emails = countable → too many.

ru.text: Задание 2: "I get too much emails at work. It takes me ages to read them all!" — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: emails = исчисляемое → too many.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "I get too much emails at work. It takes me ages to read them all!" — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: emails = sanaladi → too many.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "A: How much fruit do we have? B: Any. Can you buy some?" — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Zero quantity in short answers = None — Rule 15.

ru.text: Задание 2: "A: How much fruit do we have? B: Any. Can you buy some?" — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: Нулевое количество в кратких ответах = None — Правило 15.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "A: How much fruit do we have? B: Any. Can you buy some?" — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: Qisqa javoblarda nol miqdor = None — 15-qoida.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "There are only a little people that I can talk to about my problems." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: people = countable → a few.

ru.text: Задание 2: "There are only a little people that I can talk to about my problems." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: people = исчисляемое → a few.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "There are only a little people that I can talk to about my problems." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: people = sanaladi → a few.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "Katarina has plenty of money, so she always has the latest phone." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: plenty of + noun = more than enough — correct.

ru.text: Задание 2: "Katarina has plenty of money, so she always has the latest phone." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: plenty of + существительное = более чем достаточно — правильно.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "Katarina has plenty of money, so she always has the latest phone." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: plenty of + ot = yetaridan ham koʻp — toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 1 (Inbox messages): "If you can ___ an email in less than two minutes, do it right away." (verb list)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key verbs: answer, click, find, forget, free up, keep, recycle, update — answer an email.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 1 (Сообщения во «Входящих»): "If you can ___ an email in less than two minutes, do it right away." (список глаголов)
ru.explanation: Ключевые глаголы: answer, click, find, forget, free up, keep, recycle, update — answer an email.

uz.text: Oʻqish maslahati 1 (Kiruvchi xabarlar): "If you can ___ an email in less than two minutes, do it right away." (feʼllar roʻyxati)
uz.explanation: Kalit feʼllar: answer, click, find, forget, free up, keep, recycle, update — answer an email.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 2 (Old software or apps): "Uninstall software or apps that you don't use. This will ___ a lot more space."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: free up space = make space available.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 2 (Старые программы или приложения): "Uninstall software or apps that you don't use. This will ___ a lot more space."
ru.explanation: free up space = освободить место.

uz.text: Oʻqish maslahati 2 (Eski dasturlar yoki ilovalar): "Uninstall software or apps that you don't use. This will ___ a lot more space."
uz.explanation: free up space = joy boʻshatish.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 3 (Photos): "Having poor-quality photos just makes it more difficult to ___ a good photo when you need one."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: find a good photo.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 3 (Фотографии): "Having poor-quality photos just makes it more difficult to ___ a good photo when you need one."
ru.explanation: Ключ: find a good photo.

uz.text: Oʻqish maslahati 3 (Rasmlar): "Having poor-quality photos just makes it more difficult to ___ a good photo when you need one."
uz.explanation: Kalit: find a good photo.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 4 (Friends): "Having too many friends on social media makes it more difficult to ___ in touch with the ones you really care about."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: keep in touch — fixed expression.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 4 (Друзья): «Слишком большое количество друзей в социальных сетях затрудняет ___ связи с теми, кто вам действительно дорог.»
ru.explanation: keep in touch («поддерживать связь») — устойчивое выражение.

uz.text: Oʻqish boʻyicha 4-maslahat (Doʻstlar): «Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda juda koʻp doʻst boʻlish, siz haqiqatan qadrlaydigan odamlar bilan aloqani ___ qiyinlashtiradi.»
uz.explanation: keep in touch («aloqada boʻlish») — barqaror (qatʼiy) ibora.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 5 (Contact information): "___ contact information regularly and delete contacts you no longer need."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Update contact information.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 5 (Контактные данные): «Регулярно ___ контактные данные и удаляйте контакты, которые вам больше не нужны.»
ru.explanation: Обновляйте контактные данные.

uz.text: Oʻqish boʻyicha 5-maslahat (Aloqa maʼlumotlari): «Aloqa maʼlumotlarini muntazam ravishda ___ va endi kerak boʻlmagan kontaktlarni oʻchirib tashlang.»
uz.explanation: Aloqa maʼlumotlarini yangilab turing.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 6 (Passwords): "Use a password manager app… You'll never ___ a password again."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: forget a password.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 6 (Пароли): «Пользуйтесь приложением для управления паролями… Вы больше никогда не ___ пароль.»
ru.explanation: забыть пароль.

uz.text: Oʻqish boʻyicha 6-maslahat (Parollar): «Parollarni boshqaruvchi ilovadan foydalaning… Endi hech qachon parolni ___.»
uz.explanation: parolni unutish.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 7 (Email marketing): "Just ___ on the 'unsubscribe' link at the bottom of the email."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: click on the link.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 7 (Email-рассылки): «Просто ___ по ссылке 'unsubscribe' внизу письма.»
ru.explanation: щёлкнуть по ссылке.

uz.text: Oʻqish boʻyicha 7-maslahat (Email marketingi): «Faqat xatning pastki qismidagi 'unsubscribe' havolasi ustiga ___.»
uz.explanation: havola ustiga bosing.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 8 (Old devices): "If you can't give them to somebody who would use them, ___ old devices properly."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: recycle old devices.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 8 (Старые устройства): «Если вы не можете отдать их тому, кто бы ими пользовался, ___ старые устройства надлежащим образом.»
ru.explanation: перерабатывать (утилизировать) старые устройства.

uz.text: Oʻqish boʻyicha 8-maslahat (Eski qurilmalar): «Agar ularni foydalanadigan odamga bera olmasangiz, eski qurilmalarni toʻgʻri ___.»
uz.explanation: eski qurilmalarni qayta ishlash.

shuffledQuestions.text: Prefix un-: "Why should you have hundreds of un___ or un___ emails?" — choose the pair.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key (d): unopened / unanswered emails.

ru.text: Приставка un-: «Зачем вам иметь сотни писем un___ или un___?» — выберите пару.
ru.explanation: Ответ (d): unopened / unanswered — непрочитанные или неотвеченные письма.

uz.text: un- prefiksi: «Nega sizda yuzlab un___ yoki un___ xatlar boʻlishi kerak?» — juftlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Javob (d): unopened / unanswered — ochilmagan yoki javob berilmagan xatlar.

shuffledQuestions.text: Prefix un-: "___ software or apps that you don't use." — choose the verb.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Uninstall software (Tip 2).

ru.text: Приставка un-: «___ программы или приложения, которыми вы не пользуетесь.» — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: Uninstall software — удаляйте программы (Совет 2).

uz.text: un- prefiksi: «Ishlatmaydigan dasturlaringiz yoki ilovalaringizni ___.» — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Uninstall software — dasturlarni oʻchirib tashlang (2-maslahat).

shuffledQuestions.text: Prefix un-: "You can ___ friends without them knowing." — choose the verb.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unfollow friends (Tip 4).

ru.text: Приставка un-: «Вы можете ___ друзей так, чтобы они об этом не узнали.» — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: unfollow friends — отписаться от друзей (Совет 4).

uz.text: un- prefiksi: «Doʻstlaringizni ular bilmagan holda ___ mumkin.» — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: unfollow friends — doʻstlardan obunani bekor qilish (4-maslahat).

shuffledQuestions.text: Prefix un-: "If you get ___ emails… don't just delete them — ___." — choose the pair.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unwanted emails — unsubscribe (Tip 7).

ru.text: Приставка un-: «Если вам приходят ___ письма… не просто удаляйте их — ___.» — выберите пару.
ru.explanation: unwanted (нежелательные) письма — unsubscribe (отписаться) (Совет 7).

uz.text: un- prefiksi: «Agar sizga ___ xatlar kelsa… ularni shunchaki oʻchirib tashlamang — ___.» — juftlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: unwanted (keraksiz) xatlar — unsubscribe (obunadan chiqish) (7-maslahat).

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "Why do you have over 100 ___ emails?" (un + read/lock/helpful/known…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key (e) 1: unread (or unopened) emails.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Почему у вас более 100 ___ писем?» (un + read/lock/helpful/known…)
ru.explanation: Ответ (e) 1: unread (или unopened) — непрочитанные (или неоткрытые) письма.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Nega sizda 100 dan ortiq ___ xat bor?» (un + read/lock/helpful/known…)
uz.explanation: Javob (e) 1: unread (yoki unopened) — oʻqilmagan (yoki ochilmagan) xatlar.

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "If you want to ___ what you've done, press Ctrl+Z."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: undo = cancel the last action.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Если хотите ___ сделанное, нажмите Ctrl+Z.»
ru.explanation: undo — отменить последнее действие.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Qilgan ishingizni ___ kerak boʻlsa, Ctrl+Z ni bosing.»
uz.explanation: undo — oxirgi amalni bekor qilish.

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "I had to ___ her as she was posting some really annoying things."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unfollow her.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Мне пришлось ___ её, потому что она публиковала очень раздражающие вещи.»
ru.explanation: unfollow her — отписаться от неё.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «U juda zerikarli narsalar joylab borayotgani uchun men uni ___ ga majbur boʻldim.»
uz.explanation: unfollow her — uni obunadan chiqish (unfollow qilish).

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "I can't ___ my phone — I've forgotten the password."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unlock the phone.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Я не могу ___ свой телефон — я забыл пароль.»
ru.explanation: unlock the phone — разблокировать телефон.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Telefonimni ___ olmayman — parolni unutib qoldiman.»
uz.explanation: unlock the phone — telefonni qulfdan chiqarish (ochish).

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "The IT Support person was very ___. I still can't print anything."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unhelpful.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Специалист техподдержки был очень ___. Я до сих пор не могу ничего распечатать.»
ru.explanation: unhelpful — не оказывающий помощи (бесполезный).

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «IT yordam xizmati xodimi juda ___ boʻldi. Men hali ham hech narsani chop etolmayman.»
uz.explanation: unhelpful — yordam bermaydigan (foydasi yoʻq).

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "I didn't answer the phone, because it said 'caller ___'."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: caller unknown.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Я не ответил на звонок, потому что там было написано 'caller ___'.»
ru.explanation: caller unknown — «звонящий неизвестен».

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Men telefonga javob bermadim, chunki ekranda 'caller ___' deb yozilgan edi.»
uz.explanation: caller unknown — «qoʻngʻiroq qiluvchi nomaʼlum».

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "I can't set up the new router — the instructions are really ___."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unclear instructions.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Я не могу настроить новый роутер — инструкции действительно ___.»
ru.explanation: unclear — непонятные инструкции.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Yangi routerni sozlay olmayman — koʻrsatmalar juda ___.»
uz.explanation: unclear — tushunarsiz koʻrsatmalar.

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "I hate earbuds — I find them really ___."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: uncomfortable.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Ненавижу наушники-вкладыши — они кажутся мне очень ___.»
ru.explanation: uncomfortable — неудобный.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Earbuds (quloq ichidagi naushniklar)ni yoqtirmayman — ular menga juda ___ tuyuladi.»
uz.explanation: uncomfortable — noqulay.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: What is five squared?

ru.text: Числа B A1: Чему равно пять в квадрате?

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: Beshning kvadrati nechaga teng?

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: What is the next prime number after 19?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: 21 = 3×7 and 22 = 2×11 are divisible; the next prime is 23.

ru.text: Числа B A1: Какое простое число идёт после 19?
ru.explanation: 21 = 3×7 и 22 = 2×11 делятся; следующее простое число — 23.

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: 19 dan keyingi tub son qaysi?
uz.explanation: 21 = 3×7 va 22 = 2×11 boʻlinadi; keyingi tub son — 23.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: How is the sequence 3, 9, 27, 81 created?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: 3×3=9, 9×3=27, 27×3=81 — a geometric sequence.

ru.text: Числа B A1: Как образуется последовательность 3, 9, 27, 81?
ru.explanation: 3×3=9, 9×3=27, 27×3=81 — геометрическая последовательность.

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: 3, 9, 27, 81 ketma-ketligi qanday hosil boʻladi?
uz.explanation: 3×3=9, 9×3=27, 27×3=81 — geometrik ketma-ketlik.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: What is the aggregate of this set of test marks: 6, 8, 9, 5, 6, 7?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Aggregate = total: 6+8+9+5+6+7 = 41 (average would be 41÷6 ≈ 6.8).

ru.text: Числа B A1: Чему равна сумма этого набора тестовых оценок: 6, 8, 9, 5, 6, 7?
ru.explanation: Aggregate = сумма: 6+8+9+5+6+7 = 41 (среднее было бы 41÷6 ≈ 6.8).

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: 6, 8, 9, 5, 6, 7 baholaridan iborat toʻplamning yigʻindisi (jami) qancha?
uz.explanation: Aggregate = jami: 6+8+9+5+6+7 = 41 (oʻrtacha boʻlsa 41÷6 ≈ 6.8 boʻlardi).

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: If you round up 6.66, what number do you have?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Rounding up gives the next whole number: 7.

ru.text: Числа B A1: Если округлить 6.66 вверх, какое число получится?
ru.explanation: Округление вверх даёт следующее целое число: 7.

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: 6.66 ni yuqoriga yaxlitlasangiz, qanday son hosil boʻladi?
uz.explanation: Yuqoriga yaxlitlash keyingi butun sonni beradi: 7.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: 3/4 and 4 — which is a whole number and which is a fraction?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: 3/4 is a fraction, 4 is a whole number
shuffledQuestions.optionB: 3/4 is a whole number, 4 is a fraction
shuffledQuestions.explanation: A fraction shows parts of a whole; 4 is a complete (whole) number.

ru.text: Числа B A1: 3/4 и 4 — какое из них целое число, а какое — дробь?
ru.explanation: Дробь показывает части целого; 4 — полное (целое) число.

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: 3/4 va 4 — qaysi biri butun son, qaysi biri kasr?
uz.explanation: Kasr butunning qismlarini koʻrsatadi; 4 — toʻliq (butun) son.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A1: Is an accountant pleased or displeased if the figures he/she is checking tally?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: If figures tally, they match/agree, so there is no error to investigate.

ru.text: Числа B A1: Доволен или недоволен бухгалтер, если проверяемые им цифры сходятся (tally)?
ru.explanation: Если цифры tally (сходятся), они совпадают, значит, ошибки, которую нужно расследовать, нет.

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: Tekshirayotgan raqamlari tally (mos kelsa), buxgalter xursand boʻladimi yoki norozi boʻladimi?
uz.explanation: Agar raqamlar tally (mos kelsa), demak ular bir-biriga toʻgʻri keladi va tekshirish kerak boʻlgan xato yoʻq.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "You could ___ the total number of private cars that use the tunnel each week." (c…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: calculate = work out (Rule 16).

ru.text: Числа B A2: «Вы могли бы ___ общее число частных автомобилей, которые каждую неделю проезжают через тоннель.» (c…)
ru.explanation: calculate = work out (Правило 16).

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «Har hafta tunneldan foydalanadigan xususiy avtomobillarning umumiy sonini ___ mumkin edi.» (c…)
uz.explanation: calculate = work out (16-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "…and get an ___ figure for how much carbon they're all emitting." (a…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: approximate = a roughly correct figure.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «…и получить ___ значение того, сколько углерода выбрасывают они все.» (a…)
ru.explanation: approximate = примерно верное значение.

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «…va ularning barchasi qancha uglerod chiqarayotgani haqida ___ raqamga ega boʻlish.» (a…)
uz.explanation: approximate = taxminan toʻgʻri raqam.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "How ___ would that figure have to be?" (p…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: precise = exact.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «Насколько ___ должно быть это значение?» (p…)
ru.explanation: precise = точный.

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «Bu raqam qanchalik ___ boʻlishi kerak?» (p…)
uz.explanation: precise = aniq.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "you just need to ___ more or less what the total pollution will be" (e…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: estimate = make a rough guess.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «вам просто нужно ___, более или менее, каким будет общее загрязнение» (e…)
ru.explanation: estimate = сделать приблизительную оценку.

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «sizga shunchaki umumiy ifloslanish qanday boʻlishini taxminan ___ kerak» (e…)
uz.explanation: estimate = taxminiy baho berish.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "check to see if those figures ___ with the figures that have already been published" (t…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: tally with = match, agree.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «проверьте, ___ ли эти цифры с цифрами, которые уже были опубликованы» (t…)
ru.explanation: tally with = совпадать, сходиться.

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «bu raqamlar allaqachon eʼlon qilingan raqamlar bilan ___ini tekshirib koʻring» (t…)
uz.explanation: tally with = mos kelmoq, toʻgʻri kelmoq.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "And the figure won't be ___, of course; it'll go up and down…" (c…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: constant = staying the same — the figure goes up and down, so it is not constant.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «И это значение, конечно, не будет ___; оно будет то расти, то падать…» (c…)
ru.explanation: constant = оставаться неизменным — значение растёт и падает, значит, оно не постоянное.

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «Va bu raqam, albatta, ___ boʻlmaydi; u baland-past boʻlib turadi…» (c…)
uz.explanation: constant = oʻzgarmas qolmoq — raqam baland-past boʻlib turgani uchun u oʻzgarmas emas.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "Should I present each daily total as a ___ item…?" (d…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: discrete = a separate item that cannot be divided (Rule 16).

ru.text: Числа B A2: «Должен ли я представлять каждую дневную сумму как ___ элемент…?» (d…)
ru.explanation: discrete = отдельный элемент, который нельзя разделить (Правило 16).

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «Har bir kunlik jami miqdorni ___ element sifatida koʻrsatishim kerakmi…?» (d…)
uz.explanation: discrete = boʻlinmaydigan alohida element (16-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "you can ___ it up or down to the nearest 100" — choose the verb.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: round up / round down — the fixed pair.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «вы можете ___ его вверх или вниз до ближайших 100» — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: round up / round down — устойчивая пара.

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «uni eng yaqin 100 gacha yuqoriga yoki pastga ___ mumkin» — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: round up / round down — barqaror juftlik.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A3 (ESTIMATE): "We made a rough guess at what the final figure might be." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: We estimated roughly at the final figure might be.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: We made a rough estimate on what the final figure might be.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: We made a rough estimate of what the final figure might be.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: We did a rough estimate about the figure final.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: estimate (verb) → estimate (noun) + of.

ru.text: Числа B A3 (ESTIMATE): «Мы сделали приблизительную догадку о том, каким может оказаться итоговое значение.» → выберите перефразировку.
ru.explanation: estimate (глагол) → estimate (существительное) + of.

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (ESTIMATE): «Yakuniy raqam qanday boʻlishi mumkinligi haqida taxminiy fikr bildirdik.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: estimate (feʼl) → estimate (ot) + of.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A3 (MAGNITUDE): "The graph shows the results from the lowest to the highest." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: The graph shows the magnitude results lowest to highest.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: The graph shows the results by magnitude order, from the lowest to the highest.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: The graph magnitudes the results from lowest to highest.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: The graph shows the results in order of magnitude, from the lowest to the highest.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Fixed phrase: in order of magnitude.

ru.text: Числа B A3 (MAGNITUDE): «График показывает результаты от наименьшего к наибольшему.» → выберите перефразировку.
ru.explanation: Устойчивое выражение: in order of magnitude.

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (MAGNITUDE): «Grafik natijalarni eng pastdan eng yuqorigacha koʻrsatadi.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Barqaror ibora: in order of magnitude.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A3 (CALCULATE): "A computer program helped us work out the significance of the different variables." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: A computer program helped us calculating the significance…
shuffledQuestions.optionB: A computer program helped us calculate the significance of the different variables.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: A computer program calculated to us the significance…
shuffledQuestions.optionD: A computer program helped us calculation the significance…
shuffledQuestions.explanation: work out → calculate.

ru.text: Числа B A3 (CALCULATE): «Компьютерная программа помогла нам вычислить значимость различных переменных.» → выберите перефразировку.
ru.explanation: work out → calculate.

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (CALCULATE): «Kompyuter dasturi turli oʻzgaruvchilarning ahamiyatini hisoblab chiqishimizga yordam berdi.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: work out → calculate.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A3 (SUBTRACT): "Taking x away from y will help you arrive at the correct answer." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Subtracting x of y will help you arrive at the correct answer.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Subtracting x from y will help you arrive at the correct answer.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: Subtracted from x y will help you arrive at the correct answer.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Subtract x away y will help you arrive at the correct answer.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: subtract x from y; gerund subject Subtracting…

ru.text: Числа B A3 (SUBTRACT): «Вычитание x из y поможет вам прийти к правильному ответу.» → выберите перефразировку.
ru.explanation: subtract x from y; подлежащее-герундий: Subtracting…

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (SUBTRACT): «y dan x ni ayirish toʻgʻri javobga erishishga yordam beradi.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: subtract x from y; gerund ega: Subtracting…

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A3 (TALLY): "The results from the first experiment were not the same as those we got from the repeat experiment." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: The results did not tally the repeat experiment.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: The results from the first experiment did not tally with those we got from the repeat experiment.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: The results from the first experiment did not tally to those we got…
shuffledQuestions.optionD: The results were not tallying with the repeat experiment.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: tally with = match.

ru.text: Числа B A3 (TALLY): «Результаты первого эксперимента не совпали с результатами повторного эксперимента.» → выберите перефразировку.
ru.explanation: tally with = совпадать.

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (TALLY): «Birinchi tajriba natijalari takroriy tajribadan olingan natijalar bilan bir xil boʻlmadi.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: tally with = mos kelmoq.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "Don't forget to show your ___." (all the calculations leading up to an answer)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: workings = all the calculations shown step by step.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «Не забудьте показать ваши ___.» (все вычисления, приводящие к ответу)
ru.explanation: workings = все вычисления, показанные шаг за шагом.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «Oʻz ___ ni koʻrsatishni unutmang.» (javobga olib boradigan barcha hisob-kitoblar)
uz.explanation: workings = qadam-baqadam koʻrsatilgan barcha hisob-kitoblar.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "It is a good idea to show how you ___ your ___." (the verb + the numbers)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: arrive at your figures — the collocation is arrive at.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «Хорошая идея — показать, как вы ___ свои ___.» (глагол + числа)
ru.explanation: arrive at your figures — устойчивое сочетание: arrive at.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «Oʻz ___ ni qanday qilib ___ chiqqaningizni koʻrsatish — yaxshi gʻoya.» (feʼl + raqamlar)
uz.explanation: arrive at your figures — barqaror birikma: arrive at.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "…answers that are hardly even in the right ___." (approximately correct)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: in the right area = approximately correct.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «…ответы, которые даже близко не лежат в правильном ___.» (приблизительно правильные)
ru.explanation: in the right area = приблизительно правильный.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «…hatto toʻgʻri ___ ga ham yaqin kelmaydigan javoblar.» (taxminan toʻgʻri)
uz.explanation: in the right area = taxminan toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "we must be able to distinguish all your ___." (legible writing)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: calculations — the key for gap 5.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «мы должны быть в состоянии разобрать все ваши ___.» (разборчивое письмо)
ru.explanation: calculations — ключ для пропуска 5.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «biz sizning barcha ___ ni ajratib oʻqishimiz kerak.» (oʻqiladigan yozuv)
uz.explanation: calculations — 5-boʻshliq uchun javob.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "When doing graphs, plot the ___ carefully" (individual data points)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: plot the values.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «Строя графики, аккуратно наносите ___» (отдельные точки данных)
ru.explanation: plot the values — нанесите значения на график.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «Grafiklar tuzayotganda ___ ni sinchkovlik bilan joylashtiring» (alohida maʼlumot nuqtalari)
uz.explanation: plot the values — qiymatlarni grafikga joylashtirmoq.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "take all ___ into account" (the things that can change)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: take all variables into account.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «принимайте во внимание все ___» (то, что может меняться)
ru.explanation: take all variables into account — учитывайте все переменные.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «barcha ___ ni hisobga oling» (oʻzgarishi mumkin boʻlgan narsalar)
uz.explanation: take all variables into account — barcha oʻzgaruvchilarni hisobga oling.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: Which word from the box is NOT needed?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The extra word is reached — the email uses arrive at.

ru.text: Числа B A4: Какое слово из рамки НЕ нужно?
ru.explanation: Лишнее слово — reached: в письме используется arrive at.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: Ramkadagi qaysi soʻz KERAK EMAS?
uz.explanation: Ortiqcha soʻz — reached: xatda arrive at ishlatilgan.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.1: "the highest percentage of smokers" matches which student citation?
shuffledQuestions.optionB: B — Naples has the highest proportion of smokers
shuffledQuestions.optionC: C — two per cent of the US population
shuffledQuestions.optionD: D — only a small minority of US workers
shuffledQuestions.explanation: 1 → B: percentage → proportion.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.1: «the highest percentage of smokers» — какой студенческой цитате это соответствует?
ru.explanation: 1 → B: percentage → proportion.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 1: «the highest percentage of smokers» — qaysi talaba iqtibosiga mos keladi?
uz.explanation: 1 → B: percentage → proportion.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.1: "this small fraction of the population" matches which student citation?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: B — the highest proportion of smokers
shuffledQuestions.optionB: A — the majority of those questioned
shuffledQuestions.optionC: D — only a small minority of US workers (around 5%)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: 2 → D: a small fraction = a small minority.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.1: «this small fraction of the population» — какой студенческой цитате это соответствует?
ru.explanation: 2 → D: a small fraction = a small minority.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 1: «this small fraction of the population» — qaysi talaba iqtibosiga mos keladi?
uz.explanation: 2 → D: a small fraction = a small minority.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.2: "This type of treatment is appropriate in only a minority of cases." — large (L) or small (S)?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a minority = small quantity.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.2: «Этот вид лечения подходит лишь в меньшинстве случаев.» — большое (L) или малое (S)?
ru.explanation: a minority = малое количество.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 2: «Bu davolash turi faqat holatlarning kichik qismida mos keladi.» — katta (L) yoki kichik (S)?
uz.explanation: a minority = kichik miqdor.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.2: "Fuel costs make up a tiny fraction of the firm's total operating costs." — L or S?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a tiny fraction = small.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.2: «Расходы на топливо составляют крошечную долю общих операционных расходов фирмы.» — L или S?
ru.explanation: a tiny fraction = малая величина.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 2: «Yoqilgʻi xarajatlari firmaning umumiy operatsion xarajatlarining juda kichik ulushini tashkil etadi.» — L yoki S?
uz.explanation: a tiny fraction = kichik.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.2: "The majority of students at the college speak English as a second language." — L or S?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the majority = large.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.2: «Большинство студентов колледжа говорят по-английски как на втором языке.» — L или S?
ru.explanation: the majority = большая часть.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 2: «Kollejdagi talabalarning aksariyati ingliz tilini ikkinchi til sifatida gaplashadi.» — L yoki S?
uz.explanation: the majority = katta qism.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.2: "A high proportion of their income is spent on food…" — L or S?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a high proportion = large.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.2: «Большая доля их дохода тратится на еду…» — L или S?
ru.explanation: a high proportion = большая доля.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 2: «Ularining daromadining katta qismi ovqatga sarflanadi…» — L yoki S?
uz.explanation: a high proportion = katta ulush.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.2: "This disease affects a relatively small percentage of the population." — L or S?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a small percentage = small.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.2: «Эта болезнь поражает относительно небольшой процент населения.» — L или S?
ru.explanation: a small percentage = малый процент.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 2: «Bu kasallik aholining nisbatan kichik foiziga taʼsir qiladi.» — L yoki S?
uz.explanation: a small percentage = kichik foiz.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (FRACTION): "These examples represent only ___ the total number of cases (less than 4%)."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a small fraction of + noun.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (FRACTION): «Эти примеры представляют лишь ___ общего числа случаев (менее 4%).»
ru.explanation: a small fraction of + существительное.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (FRACTION): «Bu misollar holatlar umumiy sonining atigi ___ ni tashkil etadi (4% dan kam).»
uz.explanation: a small fraction of + ot.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (MAJORITY): "The survey found that ___ customers (82%) are satisfied with the service."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the majority of + noun.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (MAJORITY): «Опрос показал, что ___ клиентов (82%) довольны обслуживанием.»
ru.explanation: the majority of + существительное.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (MAJORITY): «Soʻrov shuni koʻrsatdiki, mijozlarning ___ (82%) xizmatdan mamnun.»
uz.explanation: the majority of + ot.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (PROPORTION): "___ patients (approximately 10%) suffer more severe symptoms."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: A small proportion of patients (≈10%).

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (PROPORTION): «___ пациентов (примерно 10%) страдают более тяжёлыми симптомами.»
ru.explanation: A small proportion of patients (≈10%) — небольшая доля пациентов.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (PROPORTION): «Bemorlarning ___ (taxminan 10%) ogʻirroq alomatlar bilan aziyat chekadi.»
uz.explanation: A small proportion of patients (≈10%) — bemorlarning kichik qismi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (PER CENT): "In 1900, only 20 ___ American women worked outside the home."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: per cent after a number (Rule 17): 20 per cent of.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (PER CENT): «В 1900 году лишь 20 ___ американок работали вне дома.»
ru.explanation: per cent после числа (Правило 17): 20 per cent of.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (PER CENT): «1900-yilda faqat 20 ___ amerikalik ayollar uydan tashqarida ishlagan.»
uz.explanation: per cent sondan keyin (17-qoida): 20 per cent of.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (MINORITY): "In ___ people (less than 3%), the problem may continue into adulthood."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a small minority of people.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (MINORITY): «У ___ людей (менее 3%) проблема может сохраняться и во взрослом возрасте.»
ru.explanation: a small minority of people — небольшое меньшинство людей.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (MINORITY): «Odamlarning ___ (3% dan kam)da muammo voyaga yetgan davrgacha davom etishi mumkin.»
uz.explanation: a small minority of people — odamlarning kichik qismi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.4: "You can use an ___ to represent a typical ___ for a set of data." (box: average, value…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: an average represents a typical value.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.4: «Можно использовать ___, чтобы представить типичное ___ для набора данных.» (рамка: average, value…)
ru.explanation: average (среднее) представляет типичное значение (value).

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 4: «Maʼlumotlar toʻplami uchun tipik ___ ni ifodalash uchun ___ dan foydalanishingiz mumkin.» (ramka: average, value…)
uz.explanation: average (oʻrtacha) — tipik qiymatni (value) ifodalaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.4: "The most common way of measuring an average is called the ___."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The mean is the most common average.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.4: «Самый распространённый способ вычисления среднего называется ___.»
ru.explanation: mean (среднее арифметическое) — самый распространённый вид среднего.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 4: «Oʻrtachani oʻlchashning eng keng tarqalgan usuli ___ deb ataladi.»
uz.explanation: mean (oʻrtacha arifmetik) — eng keng tarqalgan oʻrtacha.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.4: "You can ___ the mean using the ___ shown in the text."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: calculate the mean using the formula.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.4: «Вы можете ___ среднее с помощью ___, показанного в тексте.»
ru.explanation: вычислить среднее по формуле.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 4: «Matnda keltirilgan ___ yordamida mean ni ___ mumkin.»
uz.explanation: formuladan foydalanib mean ni hisoblash.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.4: "You work out the ___ of all the values, then you ___ that by the number of values."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: total first, then divide by the count (Rule 18).

ru.text: Числа C Упр.4: «Вы находите ___ всех значений, затем ___ это на количество значений.»
ru.explanation: сначала total (сумма), затем деление на количество (Правило 18).

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 4: «Barcha qiymatlarning ___ chiqarasiz, keyin buni qiymatlar soniga ___.»
uz.explanation: avval total (jami), keyin soniga boʻlish (18-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.5: 6 + 9 + 3 + 9 + 7 circled in the picture — this is the…
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The circled sum is the total.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.5: 6 + 9 + 3 + 9 + 7 обведено на картинке — это…
ru.explanation: Обведённая сумма — это total (сумма).

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 5: rasmda 6 + 9 + 3 + 9 + 7 doiraga olingan — bu…
uz.explanation: Doiraga olingan yigʻindi — bu total.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.5: (n+1)/2 bracketed in the picture — this is a…
shuffledQuestions.explanation: A mathematical expression like (n+1)/2 is a formula.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.5: (n+1)/2 взято в скобки на картинке — это…
ru.explanation: Математическое выражение вроде (n+1)/2 — это формула.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 5: rasmda (n+1)/2 qavsga olingan — bu…
uz.explanation: (n+1)/2 kabi matematik ifoda — bu formula.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.5: the fraction line labelled in the picture — this means…
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The line between numbers means divide by.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.5: дробная черта, обозначенная на картинке, — это означает…
ru.explanation: Черта между числами означает деление.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 5: rasmda belgilangan kasr chizigʻi — bu quyidagini anglatadi…
uz.explanation: Sonlar orasidagi chiziq boʻlishni anglatadi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.5: the pie chart sectors 15% and 85% — label them.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The 85% sector is the majority; 15% is the minority.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.5: секторы круговой диаграммы 15% и 85% — подпишите их.
ru.explanation: Сектор 85% — это majority (большинство); 15% — minority (меньшинство).

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 5: doiraviy diagrammaning 15% va 85% sektorlari — ularni belgilang.
uz.explanation: 85% sektor — koʻpchilik (majority); 15% — kamchilik (minority).

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "To ___ the ___ rainfall for this whole period…" (gaps 1–2)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: calculate the average rainfall.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «Чтобы ___ ___ количество осадков за весь этот период…» (пропуски 1–2)
ru.explanation: вычислить среднее количество осадков.

uz.text: Madeira matni: «Butun bu davr uchun ___ yomgʻin miqdorini ___ uchun…» (boʻshliqlar 1–2)
uz.explanation: oʻrtacha (average) yogʻin miqdorini hisoblash.

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "we first work out the ___ of the rainfall ___ for these six months" (gaps 3–4)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the total of the rainfall values.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «сначала мы вычисляем ___ всех ___ осадков за эти шесть месяцев» (пропуски 3–4)
ru.explanation: сумма (total) значений осадков.

uz.text: Madeira matni: «avval biz bu olti oy uchun yogʻin ___ ni ___ chiqaramiz» (boʻshliqlar 3–4)
uz.explanation: yogʻin qiymatlarining jami (total).

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "Then we ___ this by the number of months" (gap 5)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: divide the total by the count.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «Затем мы ___ это на число месяцев» (пропуск 5)
ru.explanation: разделить сумму на количество.

uz.text: Madeira matni: «Keyin biz buni oylar soniga ___.» (5-boʻshliq)
uz.explanation: jami miqdorni soniga boʻlish.

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "So 77.66 mm is the ___ amount of rain… Looking at these ___…" (gaps 6–7)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the average amount; looking at these figures.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «Таким образом, 77.66 мм — это ___ количество дождя… Если посмотреть на эти ___…» (пропуски 6–7)
ru.explanation: среднее (average) количество; глядя на эти значения (figures).

uz.text: Madeira matni: «Demak, 77.66 mm — bu ___ yomgʻir miqdori… Bu ___ ga qarasak…» (boʻshliqlar 6–7)
uz.explanation: oʻrtacha (average) miqdor; bu raqamlarga (figures) qaraganda.

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "the ___ of wet days each month is relatively low… for the ___ of the year… a large ___ of the year" (gaps 8–10)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the number of wet days; the majority of the year; a large proportion of the year.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «___ дождливых дней в каждом месяце относительно невелико… в течение ___ года… большая ___ года» (пропуски 8–10)
ru.explanation: число (number) дождливых дней; большая часть года (majority); значительная доля года (proportion).

uz.text: Madeira matni: «Har oyda yomgʻirli kunlarning ___ nisbatan kam… yilning ___ uchun… yilning katta ___» (boʻshliqlar 8–10)
uz.explanation: yomgʻirli kunlar soni (number); yilning aksariyati (majority); yilning katta qismi (proportion).

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ active volcanoes are there throughout the world?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: volcanoes = countable → How many.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ действующих вулканов существует по всему миру?»
ru.explanation: volcanoes — исчисляемое → How many.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Butun dunyoda ___ faol vulqonlar bor?»
uz.explanation: volcanoes — sanaladi → How many.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ oxygen is in the air?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: oxygen = uncountable → How much.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ кислорода в воздухе?»
ru.explanation: oxygen — неисчисляемое → How much.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Havoda ___ kislorod bor?»
uz.explanation: oxygen — sanalmaydi → How much.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ fish are there in the sea?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: fish (species, countable) → How many.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ рыб в море?»
ru.explanation: fish (виды рыб) — исчисляемое → How many.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Dengizda ___ baliqlar bor?»
uz.explanation: fish (baliq turlari) — sanaladi → How many.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ water is there on Earth?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: water = uncountable.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ воды на Земле?»
ru.explanation: water — неисчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Yerda ___ suv bor?»
uz.explanation: water — sanalmaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ kinds of clouds are there?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: kinds = countable.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ видов облаков существует?»
ru.explanation: kinds — исчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «___ turdagi bulutlar bor?»
uz.explanation: kinds — sanaladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ teeth does an adult human have?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: teeth = countable.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ зубов у взрослого человека?»
ru.explanation: teeth — исчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Voyaga yetgan odamda ___ tish bor?»
uz.explanation: teeth — sanaladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ does the Earth weigh?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: weight = mass (uncountable) → How much.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ весит Земля?»
ru.explanation: вес = масса (неисчисляемое) → How much.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Yer ___ ogʻirlikka ega?»
uz.explanation: ogʻirlik = massa (sanalmaydi) → How much.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.1: "___ oil is used in the world every day?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: oil = uncountable.

ru.text: WS Упр.1: «___ нефти используется в мире каждый день?»
ru.explanation: oil — неисчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 1: «Dunyoda har kuni ___ neft ishlatiladi?»
uz.explanation: oil — sanalmaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ rain in the Sahara Desert."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: rain = uncountable → isn't much.

ru.text: WS Упр.2: «В пустыне Сахара ___ дождя.»
ru.explanation: rain — неисчисляемое → isn't much.

uz.text: WS Mashq 2: «Sahara choʻlida ___ yomgʻir bor.»
uz.explanation: rain — sanalmaydi → isn't much.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ giant pandas left in the world."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: pandas = countable → aren't many.

ru.text: WS Упр.2: «В мире ___ осталось больших панд.»
ru.explanation: pandas — исчисляемое → aren't many.

uz.text: WS Mashq 2: «Dunyoda ___ katta pandalar qolgan.»
uz.explanation: pandas — sanaladi → aren't many.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ snow in countries near the Equator."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: snow = uncountable.

ru.text: WS Упр.2: «В странах вблизи экватора ___ снега.»
ru.explanation: snow — неисчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 2: «Ekvatorga yaqin mamlakatlarda ___ qor bor.»
uz.explanation: snow — sanalmaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ unexplored places left on Earth."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: places = countable.

ru.text: WS Упр.2: «На Земле ___ осталось неисследованных мест.»
ru.explanation: places — исчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 2: «Yerda ___ oʻrganilmagan joylar qolgan.»
uz.explanation: places — sanaladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ people living in the Antarctic."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: people = countable.

ru.text: WS Упр.2: «В Антарктике живёт ___ людей.»
ru.explanation: people — исчисляемое.

uz.text: WS Mashq 2: «Antarktidada ___ odamlar yashaydi.»
uz.explanation: people — sanaladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ light in the ocean below 200 metres."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: light = uncountable.

ru.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ light in the ocean below 200 metres."
ru.explanation: light — неисчисляемое (uncountable).

uz.text: WS 2-mashq: "There ___ light in the ocean below 200 metres."
uz.explanation: light — sanalmas (uncountable).

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ iron in the human body."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: iron = uncountable.

ru.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ iron in the human body."
ru.explanation: iron — неисчисляемое (uncountable).

uz.text: WS 2-mashq: "There ___ iron in the human body."
uz.explanation: iron — sanalmas (uncountable).

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ mountains on Earth higher than 7,000 metres."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: mountains = countable.

ru.text: WS Ex.2: "There ___ mountains on Earth higher than 7,000 metres."
ru.explanation: mountains — исчисляемое (countable).

uz.text: WS 2-mashq: "There ___ mountains on Earth higher than 7,000 metres."
uz.explanation: mountains — sanaladigan (countable).

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.3 (FEW): "In fact there are only one or two ways of doing this." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: In fact there are few of ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: In fact there are few ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: In fact there is few ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: In fact there are a few ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: few (without a) = almost none — matches "only one or two".

ru.text: WS Ex.3 (FEW): "In fact there are only one or two ways of doing this." → выберите перефразированный вариант.
ru.explanation: few (без a) = почти ничего — соответствует «only one or two».

uz.text: WS 3-mashq (FEW): "In fact there are only one or two ways of doing this." → qayta ifodalangan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: few (aʼsiz) = deyarli yoʻq — «only one or two» (faqat bitta-ikkita) ga mos keladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.3 (NO): "Divers could not survive at such depths." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: No divers could survive at such depths.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Any divers could not survive at such depths.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: None divers could survive at such depths.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Not no divers could survive at such depths.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: no + affirmative verb.

ru.text: WS Ex.3 (NO): "Divers could not survive at such depths." → выберите перефразированный вариант.
ru.explanation: no + утвердительная форма глагола.

uz.text: WS 3-mashq (NO): "Divers could not survive at such depths." → qayta ifodalangan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: no + tasdiq shaklidagi feʼl.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.3 (A FEW): "Some people have descended this far in underwater vessels called bathyscaphes." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Few people have descended this far… (same as some)
shuffledQuestions.optionB: A few people have descended this far in underwater vessels called bathyscaphes.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: A little people have descended this far…
shuffledQuestions.optionD: A few of people have descended this far…
