shuffledQuestions.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Choose the correct order.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Kate hardly sees ever her family.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Hardly Kate ever sees her family.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: Kate hardly ever sees her family.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Kate sees hardly ever her family.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: hardly ever behaves like a frequency adverb: before the main verb.

ru.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: hardly ever ведёт себя как наречие частотности: перед смысловым глаголом.

uz.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.
uz.explanation: hardly ever chastota ravishi kabi ishlaydi: asosiy feʼldan oldin.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.1: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a lot of / lots of are interchangeable with countable plurals (tick).

ru.text: Задание 1: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
ru.explanation: a lot of / lots of взаимозаменяемы перед исчисляемыми во множественном числе (верно).

uz.text: 1-vazifa: "My brother has downloaded ___ apps onto his new phone." (a lot of / lots of)
uz.explanation: a lot of / lots of sanaladigan koʻplik oldida almashinib ishlatiladi (toʻgʻri).

shuffledQuestions.text: Prefix un-: "If you get ___ emails… don't just delete them — ___." — choose the pair.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: unwanted emails — unsubscribe (Tip 7).

ru.text: Приставка un-: «Если вам приходят ___ письма… не просто удаляйте их — ___.» — выберите пару.
ru.explanation: unwanted (нежелательные) письма — unsubscribe (отписаться) (Совет 7).

uz.text: un- prefiksi: «Agar sizga ___ xatlar kelsa… ularni shunchaki oʻchirib tashlamang — ___.» — juftlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: unwanted (keraksiz) xatlar — unsubscribe (obunadan chiqish) (7-maslahat).

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A4: "…answers that are hardly even in the right ___." (approximately correct)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: in the right area = approximately correct.

ru.text: Числа B A4: «…ответы, которые даже близко не лежат в правильном ___.» (приблизительно правильные)
ru.explanation: in the right area = приблизительно правильный.

uz.text: Sonlar B A4: «…hatto toʻgʻri ___ ga ham yaqin kelmaydigan javoblar.» (taxminan toʻgʻri)
uz.explanation: in the right area = taxminan toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Reading tip 8 (Old devices): "If you can't give them to somebody who would use them, ___ old devices properly."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: recycle old devices.

ru.text: Совет по чтению 8 (Старые устройства): «Если вы не можете отдать их тому, кто бы ими пользовался, ___ старые устройства надлежащим образом.»
ru.explanation: перерабатывать (утилизировать) старые устройства.

uz.text: Oʻqish boʻyicha 8-maslahat (Eski qurilmalar): «Agar ularni foydalanadigan odamga bera olmasangiz, eski qurilmalarni toʻgʻri ___.»
uz.explanation: eski qurilmalarni qayta ishlash.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.2: correct the mistake: "We twice a week eat out in a restaurant."
shuffledQuestions.optionA: We eat out twice a week in a restaurant twice.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Twice a week we eat out in a restaurant twice.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: We eat twice a week out in a restaurant.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: We eat out in a restaurant twice a week.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Expression of frequency at the END of the sentence (Rule 6).

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.2: исправьте ошибку: "We twice a week eat out in a restaurant."
ru.explanation: Выражение частотности — в КОНЦЕ предложения (Правило 6).

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 2-mashq: xatoni tuzating: "We twice a week eat out in a restaurant."
uz.explanation: Takrorlik iborasi gap OXIRIDA boʻlishi kerak (6-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: Dependent prepositions: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: be used for + -ing.

ru.text: Зависимые предлоги: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
ru.explanation: be used for + -ing (использоваться для чего-либо).

uz.text: Bogʻliq predloglar: "A thermometer is used ___ measuring temperature."
uz.explanation: be used for + -ing (biror narsa uchun ishlatilmoq).

shuffledQuestions.text: "Is your mum ___ housewife?" — "No, she's ___ teacher. She's always tired when she finishes ___ work."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Professions with a/an; finish work without an article.

ru.text: «Твоя мама — ___ домохозяйка?» — «Нет, она ___ учительница. Она всегда устаёт, когда заканчивает ___ работу.»
ru.explanation: Профессии с a/an; finish work — без артикля.

uz.text: «Sening onang ___ uy bekasimi?» — «Yoʻq, u ___. U ___ ishini tugatganda doim charchaydi.»
uz.explanation: Kasblar a/an bilan; finish work artiklsiz.

shuffledQuestions.text: "The power of numbers": Why is it now quicker to analyse human genes?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Because the Human Genome Project never finished
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Because of faster computers — what took 13 years now takes a week
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Because there are fewer genes now
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The Human Genome Project took 13 years (1990-2003); faster computers now do it in a week.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Почему теперь анализ человеческих генов проходит быстрее?
ru.explanation: Проект «Геном человека» занял 13 лет (1990-2003); теперь более быстрые компьютеры делают это за неделю.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Nima uchun endi inson genlarini tahlil qilish tezroq?
uz.explanation: Inson genomi loyihasi 13 yil vaqt oldi (1990-2003); endi tezkor kompyuterlar buni bir haftada bajaradi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Prepositions of movement (time): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — choose the correct series.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: on + days, at + clock times, in + months/seasons/years.

ru.text: Предлоги движения (время): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — выберите правильную серию.
ru.explanation: on + дни, at + время на часах, in + месяцы/сезоны/годы.

uz.text: Harakat predloglari (vaqt): "___ Tuesday" / "___ 5.30" / "___ winter" — toʻgʻri ketma-ketlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: on + kunlar, at + soat vaqtlari, in + oylar/mavsumlar/yillar.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "I buy fewer e-books than I used to because I prefer physical books." — right or wrong?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: fewer + countable plural — correct.

ru.text: Задание 2: "I buy fewer e-books than I used to because I prefer physical books." — правильно или нет?
ru.explanation: fewer + исчисляемое во множественном числе — правильно.

uz.text: 2-vazifa: "I buy fewer e-books than I used to because I prefer physical books." — toʻgʻri yoki notoʻgʻri?
uz.explanation: fewer + sanaladigan koʻplik — toʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (FRACTION): "These examples represent only ___ the total number of cases (less than 4%)."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a small fraction of + noun.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (FRACTION): «Эти примеры представляют лишь ___ общего числа случаев (менее 4%).»
ru.explanation: a small fraction of + существительное.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (FRACTION): «Bu misollar holatlar umumiy sonining atigi ___ ni tashkil etadi (4% dan kam).»
uz.explanation: a small fraction of + ot.

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.3: "I ___ French because I'm going to be based in the Paris office next year." (learn)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Temporary, time-limited plan → am learning.

ru.text: BGP Упр.3: "I ___ French because I'm going to be based in the Paris office next year." (learn)
ru.explanation: Временный план, ограниченный по времени → am learning.

uz.text: BGP 3-mashq: "I ___ French because I'm going to be based in the Paris office next year." (learn)
uz.explanation: Vaqtinchalik, muddati cheklangan reja → am learning.

shuffledQuestions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…" — choose the complete correct phrase pair.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: In person, I don't think people shall need a driving licence
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Personally, I don't think people should need a driving licence
shuffledQuestions.optionC: Personal, I don't think people should needing a driving licence
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Personally, I am not thinking people should need a driving licence
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The box trains Personally / should need: opinion adverb + should + infinitive (Rule 7).

ru.text: Выражение своего мнения (3.13): «___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…» — выберите полную правильную пару фраз.
ru.explanation: Упражнение отрабатывает Personally / should need: наречие мнения + should + инфинитив (Правило 7).

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…» — toʻliq toʻgʻri iboralar juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: Mashq Personally / should need ni mustahkamlaydi: fikr ravishi + should + asosiy shakl (7-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.2: "She ___ discussions with them" (have) — choose the correct form.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Ongoing now → is having discussions.

ru.text: BGP Упр.2: "She ___ discussions with them" (have) — выберите правильную форму.
ru.explanation: Длится прямо сейчас → is having discussions.

uz.text: BGP 2-mashq: "She ___ discussions with them" (have) — toʻgʻri shaklni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Ayni paytda davom etmoqda → is having discussions.

shuffledQuestions.text: un- words: "If you want to ___ what you've done, press Ctrl+Z."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: undo = cancel the last action.

ru.text: Слова с un-: «Если хотите ___ сделанное, нажмите Ctrl+Z.»
ru.explanation: undo — отменить последнее действие.

uz.text: un- soʻzlari: «Qilgan ishingizni ___ kerak boʻlsa, Ctrl+Z ni bosing.»
uz.explanation: undo — oxirgi amalni bekor qilish.

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.5: "___ what Mrs Ericson ___? She's not in her office." (you / know — she / do)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Stative know → present simple; action → is doing.

ru.text: BGP Упр.5: "___ what Mrs Ericson ___? She's not in her office." (you / know — she / do)
ru.explanation: Глагол состояния know → present simple; действие → is doing.

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "___ what Mrs Ericson ___? She's not in her office." (you / know — she / do)
uz.explanation: Statik know → present simple; harakat → is doing.

shuffledQuestions.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Choose the correct sentence.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: My neighbours doesn't have any children.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: My neighbours aren't have any children.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: My neighbours don't have any children.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: My neighbours not have any children.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: don't have any — plural subject, any in negatives.

ru.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: don't have any — подлежащее во множественном числе, any в отрицаниях.

uz.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: don't have any — koʻplikdagi ega, inkor gapda any.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.7 (e): "___ of deserts consist of sand dunes" (Lots / Lot)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Lots of deserts — Lot alone is wrong.

ru.text: WS Ex.7 (e): "___ of deserts consist of sand dunes" (Lots / Lot)
ru.explanation: Lots of deserts — одиночное Lot неправильно.

uz.text: WS 7-mashq (e): "___ of deserts consist of sand dunes" (Lots / Lot)
uz.explanation: Lots of deserts — yolgʻiz Lot notoʻgʻri.

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.3: "We ___ out any orders this week because we're waiting for the new lists." (not / send)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: this week = temporary → present continuous: aren't sending.

ru.text: BGP Упр.3: "We ___ out any orders this week because we're waiting for the new lists." (not / send)
ru.explanation: this week = временный период → present continuous: aren't sending.

uz.text: BGP 3-mashq: "We ___ out any orders this week because we're waiting for the new lists." (not / send)
uz.explanation: this week = vaqtinchalik davr → present continuous: aren't sending.

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "the ___ of wet days each month is relatively low… for the ___ of the year… a large ___ of the year" (gaps 8–10)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the number of wet days; the majority of the year; a large proportion of the year.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «___ дождливых дней в каждом месяце относительно невелико… в течение ___ года… большая ___ года» (пропуски 8–10)
ru.explanation: число (number) дождливых дней; большая часть года (majority); значительная доля года (proportion).

uz.text: Madeira matni: «Har oyda yomgʻirli kunlarning ___ nisbatan kam… yilning ___ uchun… yilning katta ___» (boʻshliqlar 8–10)
uz.explanation: yomgʻirli kunlar soni (number); yilning aksariyati (majority); yilning katta qismi (proportion).

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.2: "we ___ after them by doing regular maintenance" (look) — choose the correct form.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: General activity → look (we look after them).

ru.text: BGP Упр.2: "we ___ after them by doing regular maintenance" (look) — выберите правильную форму.
ru.explanation: Общая деятельность → look (we look after them).

uz.text: BGP 2-mashq: "we ___ after them by doing regular maintenance" (look) — toʻgʻri shaklni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Umumiy faoliyat → look (we look after them).

shuffledQuestions.text: Generalizing (3.19): "They ___ to spend a lot of time by themselves." — choose the verb.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: tend + to + infinitive: They tend to spend…

ru.text: Обобщение (3.19): «Они ___ проводить много времени в одиночестве.» — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: tend + to + инфинитив: They tend to spend…

uz.text: Umumlashtirish (3.19): «Ular koʻp vaqtni yolgʻiz oʻtkazishga ___» — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: tend + to + infinitiv: They tend to spend…

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.3: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (verb + frequency phrase)
shuffledQuestions.optionB: eat; two or three times a month
shuffledQuestions.optionC: eat; two or three times a month ago
shuffledQuestions.optionD: make; two or three times a month
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: eat + two or three times a month; unused words: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.3: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (глагол + словосочетание частотности)
ru.explanation: Ключ: eat + два или три раза в месяц; неиспользованные слова: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 3-mashq: "I also ___ at restaurants ___." (feʼl + takrorlik iborasi)
uz.explanation: Kalit: eat + oyda ikki-uch marta; ishlatilmagan soʻzlar: always, every day, rarely, leave, make.

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.3: "Go down this road, turn right, and the road ___ straight to the industrial estate." (lead)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Permanent fact about the road → leads.

ru.text: BGP Упр.3: "Go down this road, turn right, and the road ___ straight to the industrial estate." (lead)
ru.explanation: Постоянный факт о дороге → leads.

uz.text: BGP 3-mashq: "Go down this road, turn right, and the road ___ straight to the industrial estate." (lead)
uz.explanation: Yoʻl haqidagi doimiy fakt → leads.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "You could ___ the total number of private cars that use the tunnel each week." (c…)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: calculate = work out (Rule 16).

ru.text: Числа B A2: «Вы могли бы ___ общее число частных автомобилей, которые каждую неделю проезжают через тоннель.» (c…)
ru.explanation: calculate = work out (Правило 16).

uz.text: Sonlar B A2: «Har hafta tunneldan foydalanadigan xususiy avtomobillarning umumiy sonini ___ mumkin edi.» (c…)
uz.explanation: calculate = work out (16-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you from?"
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The verb be with you → are: "Where are you from?" (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Откуда ты ___?»
ru.explanation: Глагол be с you → are: “Where are you from?” (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerdan ___?»
uz.explanation: you bilan be feʼli → are: “Where are you from?” (berilgan savol).

shuffledQuestions.text: I think ___ is more important than ___.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Uncountable abstract nouns in general statements take zero article.

ru.text: Я думаю, ___ важнее, чем ___.
ru.explanation: Несчётные абстрактные существительные в общих высказываниях — без артикля.

uz.text: Menimcha, ___ ___ dan muhimroq.
uz.explanation: Umumiy bayonlarda sanalmaydigan abstrakt otlar artiklsiz.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.2: "This disease affects a relatively small percentage of the population." — L or S?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a small percentage = small.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.2: «Эта болезнь поражает относительно небольшой процент населения.» — L или S?
ru.explanation: a small percentage = малый процент.

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 2: «Bu kasallik aholining nisbatan kichik foiziga taʼsir qiladi.» — L yoki S?
uz.explanation: a small percentage = kichik foiz.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.7 (c): "___ polar regions can be called deserts" (Many / Much)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: polar regions = countable → Many.

shuffledQuestions.text: often / late / Laila / is / work / for — Choose the correct order.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Often Laila late is for work.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Laila often is late for work.

uz.text: often / late / Laila / is / work / for — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A3 (ESTIMATE): "We made a rough guess at what the final figure might be." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: We made a rough estimate on what the final figure might be.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: We made a rough estimate of what the final figure might be.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: We estimated roughly at the final figure might be.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: We did a rough estimate about the figure final.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: estimate (verb) → estimate (noun) + of.

ru.text: Числа B A3 (ESTIMATE): «Мы сделали приблизительную догадку о том, каким может оказаться итоговое значение.» → выберите перефразировку.
ru.explanation: estimate (глагол) → estimate (существительное) + of.

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (ESTIMATE): «Yakuniy raqam qanday boʻlishi mumkinligi haqida taxminiy fikr bildirdik.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: estimate (feʼl) → estimate (ot) + of.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.3 (FEW): "In fact there are only one or two ways of doing this." → choose the rewrite.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: In fact there are a few ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.optionB: In fact there is few ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.optionC: In fact there are few of ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.optionD: In fact there are few ways of doing this.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: few (without a) = almost none — matches "only one or two".

ru.text: WS Ex.3 (FEW): "In fact there are only one or two ways of doing this." → выберите перефразированный вариант.
ru.explanation: few (без a) = почти ничего — соответствует «only one or two».

uz.text: WS 3-mashq (FEW): "In fact there are only one or two ways of doing this." → qayta ifodalangan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: few (aʼsiz) = deyarli yoʻq — «only one or two» (faqat bitta-ikkita) ga mos keladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Cause–effect connectors: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — choose the connector + noun.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: because of + noun (because needs a clause).

ru.text: Коннекторы причины–следствия: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — выберите коннектор + существительное.
ru.explanation: because of + существительное (because требует придаточного предложения).

uz.text: Sabab–natija bogʻlovchilari: "___ the increase in university students, more people now do research." — bogʻlovchi + ot juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: because of + ot (because esa qoʻshma gap talab qiladi).

shuffledQuestions.text: "What time does ___ train leave?" — "In 40 minutes. Can you drop me off at ___ station on your way to ___ work?"

uz.explanation: Ikkalasi ham aniq (the train, the station); go to work artiklsiz.

ru.explanation: do sport / do exercise (также: play + game). Ключ: do.

uz.explanation: do sport / do exercise (yana: play + game). Kalit: do.

uz.text: Sonlar B A3 (CALCULATE): «Kompyuter dasturi turli oʻzgaruvchilarning ahamiyatini hisoblab chiqishimizga yordam berdi.» → qayta yozilgan variantni tanlang.
uz.explanation: work out → calculate.

shuffledQuestions.explanation: A stereotype "can come from ideas about these groups, not truths" → B.

uz.explanation: Stereotip “can come from ideas about these groups, not truths” — bu guruhlar haqidagi tasavvurlardan kelib chiqadi, haqiqatlardan emas → B.

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.1: "What sort of quality control procedures ___?" (you / have) — choose the correct form.

ru.text: BGP Упр.1: «Какие процедуры контроля качества ___?» (you / have) — выберите правильную форму.

ru.explanation: Дробь показывает части целого; 4 — полное (целое) число.

uz.text: Sonlar B A1: 3/4 va 4 — qaysi biri butun son, qaysi biri kasr?
uz.explanation: Kasr butunning qismlarini koʻrsatadi; 4 — toʻliq (butun) son.

shuffledQuestions.text: Act.2: "My broadband isn't enough fast for me to download films easily." — right or wrong?

shuffledQuestions.text: "The power of numbers": Which has more memory — the first space shuttle computer or a smartphone?

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Qaysi birida xotira koʻp — birinchi kosmik shattl kompyuterida yoki smartfonda?
uz.explanation: Shattlda 424 KB bor edi; smartfonda esa 33,000,000 martadan koʻproq.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.4: "Other scientists argue that there is ___ chance of finding any life at all on Mars."

uz.text: WS 4-mashq: "Other scientists argue that there is ___ chance of finding any life at all on Mars."

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.4: "Unfortunately, there is ___ agreement among scientists about this."

uz.text: WS 4-mashq: "Unfortunately, there is ___ agreement among scientists about this."

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.5: "Their new 'own brand' instant coffee ___ very good, so it ___ more and more popular." (taste / become)

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.6: "You can't swim in the Dead Sea because of the large amount of salt in it." → "…because it contains too ___ salt."

ru.explanation: too much salt (слишком много соли).

uz.text: WS 6-mashq: "You can't swim in the Dead Sea because of the large amount of salt in it." → "…because it contains too ___ salt."
uz.explanation: too much salt (juda koʻp tuz).

shuffledQuestions.text: Prefix un-: "Why should you have hundreds of un___ or un___ emails?" — choose the pair.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key (d): unopened / unanswered emails.

ru.text: Приставка un-: «Зачем вам иметь сотни писем un___ или un___?» — выберите пару.
ru.explanation: Ответ (d): unopened / unanswered — непрочитанные или неотвеченные письма.

uz.text: un- prefiksi: «Nega sizda yuzlab un___ yoki un___ xatlar boʻlishi kerak?» — juftlikni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Javob (d): unopened / unanswered — ochilmagan yoki javob berilmagan xatlar.

shuffledQuestions.text: Lead-in (9.10): "I used to have ___ of different gadgets, but now I use my phone for almost everything."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Key: a lot (of different gadgets).

ru.text: Вводное задание (9.10): "I used to have ___ of different gadgets, but now I use my phone for almost everything."
ru.explanation: Ключ: a lot (of different gadgets).

uz.text: Kirish mashqi (9.10): "I used to have ___ of different gadgets, but now I use my phone for almost everything."
uz.explanation: Kalit: a lot (of different gadgets).

shuffledQuestions.text: Complete the quote (Sotomayor): "Until we get ___ equality in ___ education we will not be ___ equal society."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Uncountable abstract nouns take zero article; an + adjective (equal) + singular noun.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Sotomayor): «Пока мы не добьёмся ___ равенства в ___ образовании, мы не будем ___ равноправным обществом.»
ru.explanation: Несчётные абстрактные существительные — нулевой артикль; an + прилагательное (equal) + существительное в единственном числе.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Sotomayor): «___ tenglikni ___ taʼlimda qoʻlga kiritmagunimizcha, biz ___ teng jamiyat boʻlmaymiz.»
uz.explanation: Sanalmaydigan abstrakt otlar artiklsiz (nol artikl); an + sifat (equal) + birlikdagi ot.

shuffledQuestions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "Some people ___ (not need) a lot of sleep."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Plural people → don't need.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "Some people ___ (not need) a lot of sleep."
uz.explanation: people koʻplikda → don't need.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers B A2: "you can ___ it up or down to the nearest 100" — choose the verb.

ru.text: Числа B A2: «вы можете ___ его вверх или вниз до ближайших 100» — выберите глагол.

uz.explanation: round up / round down — barqaror juftlik.

shuffledQuestions.text: Madeira text: "Then we ___ this by the number of months" (gap 5)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: divide the total by the count.

ru.text: Текст о Мадейре: «Затем мы ___ это на число месяцев» (пропуск 5)
ru.explanation: разделить сумму на количество.

uz.text: Madeira matni: «Keyin biz buni oylar soniga ___.» (5-boʻshliq)
uz.explanation: jami miqdorni soniga boʻlish.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.3 (MAJORITY): "The survey found that ___ customers (82%) are satisfied with the service."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: the majority of + noun.

ru.text: Числа C Упр.3 (MAJORITY): «Опрос показал, что ___ клиентов (82%) довольны обслуживанием.»

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 3 (MAJORITY): «Soʻrov shuni koʻrsatdiki, mijozlarning ___ (82%) xizmatdan mamnun.»
uz.explanation: the majority of + ot.

uz.explanation: per cent sondan keyin (17-qoida): 20 per cent of.

shuffledQuestions.text: Numbers C Ex.4: "You work out the ___ of all the values, then you ___ that by the number of values."
shuffledQuestions.explanation: total first, then divide by the count (Rule 18).

ru.text: Числа C Упр.4: «Вы находите ___ всех значений, затем ___ это на количество значений.»
ru.explanation: сначала total (сумма), затем деление на количество (Правило 18).

uz.text: Sonlar C Mashq 4: «Barcha qiymatlarning ___ chiqarasiz, keyin buni qiymatlar soniga ___.»
uz.explanation: avval total (jami), keyin soniga boʻlish (18-qoida).

shuffledQuestions.text: "The power of numbers": How many people now go to university in the UK and in Finland?
shuffledQuestions.explanation: About 40% in the UK (vs ~5% in the 1960s) and 80% in Finland.

ru.text: "The power of numbers": Сколько людей теперь учится в университетах в Великобритании и в Финляндии?
ru.explanation: Около 40% в Великобритании (против ~5% в 1960-е годы) и 80% в Финляндии.

uz.text: "The power of numbers": Endi Buyuk Britaniya va Finlyandiyada necha kishi universitetda oʻqiydi?
uz.explanation: Buyuk Britaniyada taxminan 40% (1960-yillardagi ~5% ga qarshi), Finlyandiyada 80%.

shuffledQuestions.text: WS Ex.4: "…there are a ___ areas where scientists believe ice forms and melts."

uz.text: WS 4-mashq: "…there are a ___ areas where scientists believe ice forms and melts."
uz.explanation: areas — sanaladigan → a few.

shuffledQuestions.text: Test 1 checklist: When choosing an article, what should you ask?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: First mention or general → a/an; already known, unique or superlative → the; general plural/uncountable → zero

shuffledQuestions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:01–0:27): What did people tell Olivia about French people — and what did she discover?

shuffledQuestions.optionC: People told her nothing about the French before her trip.

shuffledQuestions.explanation: Before the trip people warned her; on arrival she discovered the opposite — a classic wrong stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Что люди рассказывали Olivia о французах — и что она обнаружила?
ru.explanation: До поездки люди предупреждали её; по прибытии она обнаружила обратное — классический ошибочный стереотип.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Odamlar Oliviyaga fransuzlar haqida nima dedilar — va u nimani aniqladi?

shuffledQuestions.text: BGP Ex.1: "the milk ___ down insulated pipes to the bottling plant" (pass) — choose the correct form.

ru.text: BGP Упр.1: "the milk ___ down insulated pipes to the bottling plant" (pass) — выберите правильную форму.

questions.text: Classify each decimal as terminating, repeating or nonrepeating, and state whether the corresponding number is rational or irrational: (1) $0.375$; (2) $0.272727...$; (3) $1.101001000100001...$; (4) $3.14159265...$; (5) $0.123123123...$
questions.optionA: (1) terminating, rational; (2) repeating, rational; (3) nonrepeating, irrational; (4) nonrepeating, irrational; (5) repeating, rational
questions.optionB: (1) repeating, rational; (2) terminating, rational; (3) nonrepeating, irrational; (4) repeating, irrational; (5) terminating, rational
questions.optionC: (1) terminating, irrational; (2) repeating, irrational; (3) nonrepeating, rational; (4) nonrepeating, rational; (5) repeating, irrational
questions.optionD: (1) repeating, irrational; (2) terminating, irrational; (3) nonrepeating, rational; (4) repeating, rational; (5) terminating, irrational
questions.explanation: 0.375 terminates and equals $\frac{3}{8}$ (rational). 0.272727... repeats and equals $\frac{27}{99} = \frac{3}{11}$ (rational). 1.101001000100001... has nonrepeating pattern (irrational). 3.14159265... is $\pi$ (irrational). 0.123123123... repeats and equals $\frac{123}{999} = \frac{41}{333}$ (rational).

ru.text: Классифицируйте каждую десятичную дробь как конечную, периодическую или непериодическую и укажите, рациональным или иррациональным является соответствующее число: (1) $0.375$; (2) $0.272727...$; (3) $1.101001000100001...$; (4) $3.14159265...$; (5) $0.123123123...$

options.A: (1) конечная, рациональное; (2) периодическая, рациональное; (3) непериодическая, иррациональное; (4) непериодическая, иррациональное; (5) периодическая, рациональное
options.B: (1) периодическая, рациональное; (2) конечная, рациональное; (3) непериодическая, иррациональное; (4) периодическая, иррациональное; (5) конечная, рациональное
options.C: (1) конечная, иррациональное; (2) периодическая, иррациональное; (3) непериодическая, рациональное; (4) непериодическая, рациональное; (5) периодическая, иррациональное
options.D: (1) периодическая, иррациональное; (2) конечная, иррациональное; (3) непериодическая, рациональное; (4) периодическая, рациональное; (5) конечная, иррациональное

ru.explanation: 0.375 — конечная дробь и равна $\frac{3}{8}$ (рациональное число). 0.272727... — периодическая дробь и равна $\frac{27}{99} = \frac{3}{11}$ (рациональное число). 1.101001000100001... имеет непериодическую структуру (иррациональное число). 3.14159265... — это $\pi$ (иррациональное число). 0.123123123... — периодическая дробь и равна $\frac{123}{999} = \frac{41}{333}$ (рациональное число).
