shuffledQuestions.text: A rabbit population doubles every 6 months, initially 120. a. Using $P = P_{0} a^{t}$, find a; b. when does it reach 3500?
shuffledQuestions.optionB: a. $a = 4$ per year, b. 4.87 periods (2.4 years)
shuffledQuestions.optionC: a. a = $2$ per 6-month period, b. 4.87 periods (2.4 years)
shuffledQuestions.optionE: a. a = $2$ per year, b. 4.87 periods (2.4 years)
shuffledQuestions.explanation: a. Since the population doubles every 6 months, a = $2$ per 6-month period. b. $3500 = 120·2^{t}$ gives $t = \log_{2}(29.17) \approx 4.87$ periods, which is about 2.4 years.

ru.text: Популяция кроликов удваивается каждые 6 месяцев; начальная численность 120. a. Используя $P = P_{0} a^{t}$, найдите a; b. когда она достигнет 3500?

options.B: a. $a = 4$ в год, b. 4.87 периодов (2.4 года)
options.C: a. a = $2$ за 6-месячный период, b. 4.87 периодов (2.4 года)
options.E: a. a = $2$ в год, b. 4.87 периодов (2.4 года)

ru.explanation: a. Поскольку популяция удваивается каждые 6 месяцев, a = $2$ за 6-месячный период. b. $3500 = 120·2^{t}$ даёт $t = \log_{2}(29.17) \approx 4.87$ периодов, то есть около 2.4 года.

uz.text: Quyonlar populyatsiyasi har 6 oyda ikki barobar oshadi; boshlangʻich soni 120. a. $P = P_{0} a^{t}$ orqali a ni toping; b. u qachon 3500 ga yetadi?

options.A: a. $a = 2$ har 6 oylik davr uchun, b. 29.17 oy
options.C: a. a = $2$ har 6 oylik davr uchun, b. 4.87 davr (2.4 yil)
options.E: a. a = $2$ yiliga, b. 4.87 davr (2.4 yil)

uz.explanation: a. Populyatsiya har 6 oyda ikki barobar oshgani uchun a = $2$ har 6 oylik davr uchun. b. $3500 = 120·2^{t}$ dan $t = \log_{2}(29.17) \approx 4.87$ davr, bu taxminan 2.4 yil.

shuffledQuestions.text: The 1906 San Francisco earthquake had magnitude 8.3; a Japanese quake the same year, 4.9. How much more intense was San Francisco (Richter scale)?
shuffledQuestions.optionE: About 2512 times more intense
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The intensity ratio is $10^(8.3-4.9) = 10^(3.4) \approx 2512$, meaning the San Francisco quake was about 2512 times more intense than the Japanese quake.

ru.text: Землетрясение в Сан-Франциско 1906 года имело магнитуду 8.3; японское землетрясение того же года — 4.9. Насколько интенсивнее было землетрясение в Сан-Франциско (шкала Рихтера)?
ru.explanation: Отношение интенсивностей равно $10^(8.3-4.9) = 10^(3.4) \approx 2512$, то есть землетрясение в Сан-Франциско было примерно в 2512 раз интенсивнее японского.

uz.text: 1906-yil San-Fransisko zilzilasi magnitudasi 8.3 edi; oʻsha yili sodir boʻlgan yapon zilzilasi esa 4.9. San-Fransisko zilzilasi qanchalik kuchliroq boʻlgan (Rixter shkalasi)?
uz.explanation: Intensivliklar nisbati $10^(8.3-4.9) = 10^(3.4) \approx 2512$ ga teng, yaʼni San-Fransisko zilzilasi yapon zilzilasidan taxminan 2512 marta kuchli boʻlgan.

shuffledQuestions.text: Estimate $lim t\to 0^{+} \frac{\cos(t)}{t}$ from a table of values for $t = 0.1$, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: As t approaches 0⁺, $\frac{\cos(t)}{t}$ grows without bound because the numerator approaches 1 while the denominator approaches 0⁺ from the positive side.

ru.text: Оцените $lim t\to 0^{+} \frac{\cos(t)}{t}$ по таблице значений для $t = 0.1$, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001.
ru.explanation: Когда t приближается к 0⁺, $\frac{\cos(t)}{t}$ растёт неограниченно, потому что числитель приближается к 1, а знаменатель приближается к 0⁺ с положительной стороны.

uz.text: $lim t\to 0^{+} \frac{\cos(t)}{t}$ limitni $t = 0.1$, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001 qiymatlari jadvali orqali baholang.
uz.explanation: t 0⁺ ga yaqinlashganda $\frac{\cos(t)}{t}$ chegaralanmagan holda oʻsadi, chunki surat 1 ga intiladi, maxraj esa 0⁺ ga musbat tomondan yaqinlashadi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Estimate lim $x→2$ ($x^{2}-4$)/($x-2$) from a table of values near $x=2$.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Simplifying ($x^{2}-4$)/($x-2$) to $x+2$ for $x≠2$, we find that as $x$ approaches 2, the expression approaches $2+2=4$.

ru.text: Оцените lim $x→2$ ($x^{2}-4$)/($x-2$) по таблице значений вблизи $x=2$.
ru.explanation: Упрощая ($x^{2}-4$)/($x-2$) до $x+2$ при $x≠2$, получаем, что при $x$ → 2 выражение стремится к $2+2=4$.

uz.text: lim $x→2$ ($x^{2}-4$)/($x-2$) limitni $x=2$ atrofidagi qiymatlar jadvali orqali baholang.
uz.explanation: ($x^{2}-4$)/($x-2$) ni $x≠2$ uchun $x+2$ ga soddalashtirsak, $x$ 2 ga yaqinlashganda ifoda $2+2=4$ ga intiladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Describe all vectors $c$u for $u = (2, 1)$, and all combinations $c$u + $d$v for $u = (2, 1)$, $v = (1, 2)$. When do the combinations $c$u + $d$v fill the plane?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: cu fills the line; cu+dv fills the plane when u and v are collinear
shuffledQuestions.optionB: cu fills the line; cu+dv fills the plane when u and v are perpendicular
shuffledQuestions.optionC: cu fills the line; cu+dv fills the plane when u and v are linearly independent
shuffledQuestions.optionD: cu fills the plane; cu+dv fills the line when u and v are collinear
shuffledQuestions.explanation: cu fills the line through $(2,1)$; cu+dv fills the plane when u and v are linearly independent, which is the case here since the determinant of the matrix with columns u and v is $3≠0$.

ru.text: Опишите все векторы $c$u при $u = (2, 1)$ и все комбинации $c$u + $d$v при $u = (2, 1)$, $v = (1, 2)$. Когда комбинации $c$u + $d$v заполняют всю плоскость?

options.A: cu заполняет прямую; cu+dv заполняет плоскость, когда u и v коллинеарны
options.B: cu заполняет прямую; cu+dv заполняет плоскость, когда u и v перпендикулярны
options.C: cu заполняет прямую; cu+dv заполняет плоскость, когда u и v линейно независимы
options.D: cu заполняет плоскость; cu+dv заполняет прямую, когда u и v коллинеарны

ru.explanation: cu заполняет прямую через $(2,1)$; cu+dv заполняет плоскость, когда u и v линейно независимы, что выполняется в данном случае, так как определитель матрицы со столбцами u и v равен $3≠0$.

uz.text: $u = (2, 1)$ boʻlganda barcha $c$u vektorlarni va $u = (2, 1)$, $v = (1, 2)$ boʻlganda barcha $c$u + $d$v kombinatsiyalarini tasvirlang. $c$u + $d$v kombinatsiyalari qachon butun tekislikni toʻldiradi?

options.A: cu toʻgʻri chiziqni toʻldiradi; u va v kollinear boʻlganda cu+dv tekislikni toʻldiradi
options.B: cu toʻgʻri chiziqni toʻldiradi; u va v perpendikulyar boʻlganda cu+dv tekislikni toʻldiradi
options.C: cu toʻgʻri chiziqni toʻldiradi; u va v chiziqli mustaqil boʻlganda cu+dv tekislikni toʻldiradi
options.D: cu tekislikni toʻldiradi; u va v kollinear boʻlganda cu+dv toʻgʻri chiziqni toʻldiradi

uz.explanation: cu $(2,1)$ dan oʻtuvchi toʻgʻri chiziqni toʻldiradi; u va v chiziqli mustaqil boʻlganda cu+dv tekislikni toʻldiradi — bu yerda shunday, chunki u va v ustunlardan tuzilgan matritsaning determinanti $3≠0$.

shuffledQuestions.text: Compute the dot product $u · v$ for $u = (1, 2, 1)$, $v = (3, 0, 2)$ and find a vector $w$ perpendicular to both.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: u · v = $1·3 + 2·0 + 1·2 = 5$. A perpendicular vector is the cross product $w = u × v = (4, -1, -6)$, which satisfies $w · u = 0$ and $w · v = 0$.

ru.text: Вычислите скалярное произведение $u · v$ для $u = (1, 2, 1)$, $v = (3, 0, 2)$ и найдите вектор $w$, перпендикулярный обоим.
ru.explanation: u · v = $1·3 + 2·0 + 1·2 = 5$. Перпендикулярный вектор — это векторное произведение $w = u × v = (4, -1, -6)$, которое удовлетворяет условиям $w · u = 0$ и $w · v = 0$.

uz.text: $u = (1, 2, 1)$, $v = (3, 0, 2)$ uchun skalyar koʻpaytma $u · v$ ni hisoblang va ikkalasiga ham perpendikulyar boʻlgan $w$ vektorni toping.
uz.explanation: u · v = $1·3 + 2·0 + 1·2 = 5$. Perpendikulyar vektor — bu vektor koʻpaytma $w = u × v = (4, -1, -6)$; u $w · u = 0$ va $w · v = 0$ shartlarni qanoatlantiradi.

shuffledQuestions.text: When is the dot product $u · v$ negative, and what does that say about the angle? When is it zero?
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Negative when the angle is obtuse (greater than $90°$), zero when perpendicular
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Negative when the angle is acute (less than $90°$), zero when perpendicular
shuffledQuestions.optionC: Negative when the angle is $90°$, zero when acute
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Negative when the angle is $180°$, zero when acute
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The dot product $u · v = |u||v|\cosθ$ is negative when $\cosθ < 0$, which occurs when the angle θ exceeds $90°$ (obtuse). It is zero when θ = $90°$ (perpendicular).

ru.text: Когда скалярное произведение $u · v$ отрицательно и что это говорит об угле? Когда оно равно нулю?

options.A: Отрицательно, когда угол тупой (больше $90°$), ноль — при перпендикулярности
options.B: Отрицательно, когда угол острый (меньше $90°$), ноль — при перпендикулярности
options.C: Отрицательно при угле $90°$, ноль — при остром угле
options.D: Отрицательно при угле $180°$, ноль — при остром угле

ru.explanation: Скалярное произведение $u · v = |u||v|\cosθ$ отрицательно при $\cosθ < 0$, то есть когда угол θ больше $90°$ (тупой). Оно равно нулю при θ = $90°$ (перпендикулярность).

uz.text: Skalyar koʻpaytma $u · v$ qachon manfiy boʻladi va bu burchak haqida nima deydi? Qachon u nol boʻladi?

options.A: Burchak keng ($90°$ dan katta) boʻlganda manfiy, perpendikulyar boʻlganda nol
options.B: Burchak oʻtkir ($90°$ dan kichik) boʻlganda manfiy, perpendikulyar boʻlganda nol
options.C: Burchak $90°$ boʻlganda manfiy, oʻtkir boʻlganda nol
options.D: Burchak $180°$ boʻlganda manfiy, oʻtkir boʻlganda nol

uz.explanation: $u · v = |u||v|\cosθ$ skalyar koʻpaytma $\cosθ < 0$ boʻlganda manfiy; bu θ burchak $90°$ dan oshganda (keng burchak) roʻy beradi. θ = $90°$ (perpendikulyar) boʻlganda esa nol boʻladi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Solve $Ax = b$ with $A = \begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ and $b = \begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$ using $A^{-1}$.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: $\det(A) = 3$, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$, so $x = A^{-1}b = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2/3\\5/3\end{pmatrix}$.

ru.text: Решите $Ax = b$ с $A = \begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ и $b = \begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$, используя $A^{-1}$.
ru.explanation: $\det(A) = 3$, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$, поэтому $x = A^{-1}b = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2/3\\5/3\end{pmatrix}$.

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$ va $b = \begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$ boʻlganda $Ax = b$ tenglamani $A^{-1}$ yordamida yeching.
uz.explanation: $\det(A) = 3$, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$, demak $x = A^{-1}b = \frac{1}{3}\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix}2/3\\5/3\end{pmatrix}$.

shuffledQuestions.text: Why does a nonzero solution of $Ax = 0$ rule out an inverse? Give the 2-sentence reason the Notes call 'no matrix can bring 0 back to x'.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: Because $A$ would have to map $0$ to $x$, but $A(0) = 0$ always, so $x$ must be $0$
shuffledQuestions.optionB: Because $A$ would need to be a square matrix, which isn't guaranteed by $Ax = 0$
shuffledQuestions.optionC: Because if $Ax = 0$ with $x \neq 0$, then $x = A^{-1}0 = 0$, creating a contradiction
shuffledQuestions.optionD: Because the determinant would be zero, making $A$ singular
shuffledQuestions.explanation: If $Ax = 0$ with $x \neq 0$ and $A$ had an inverse, then $x = A^{-1}Ax = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — a contradiction. The zero vector has no 'pre-image trouble' only when the map is one-to-one; a null vector proves it is not.

ru.text: Почему ненулевое решение $Ax = 0$ исключает существование обратной матрицы? Приведите состоящее из двух фраз объяснение, которое в конспектах называется «никакая матрица не может вернуть 0 обратно в x».

options.A: Потому что $A$ должна была бы отображать $0$ в $x$, но всегда $A(0) = 0$, поэтому $x$ должно равняться $0$
options.B: Потому что $A$ должна быть квадратной матрицей, а это не гарантируется условием $Ax = 0$
options.C: Потому что если $Ax = 0$ при $x \neq 0$, то $x = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — возникает противоречие
options.D: Потому что определитель был бы равен нулю, что делает $A$ вырожденной

ru.explanation: Если $Ax = 0$ при $x \neq 0$ и у $A$ есть обратная матрица, то $x = A^{-1}Ax = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — противоречие. «Проблемы с прообразом» нет только тогда, когда отображение взаимно однозначно; а нулевой вектор доказывает, что это не так.

uz.text: $Ax = 0$ ning noldan farq qiluvchi yechimi nima uchun teskari matritsa mavjudligini istisno qiladi? Konspektlarda «hech qanday matritsa 0 ni yana x ga qaytara olmaydi» deb atalgan ikki jumlali asosni keltiring.

options.A: Chunki $A$ $0$ ni $x$ ga akslantirishi kerak boʻlar edi, lekin har doim $A(0) = 0$, demak $x$ albatta $0$ boʻlishi kerak
options.B: Chunki $A$ kvadrat matritsa boʻlishi kerak, bu esa $Ax = 0$ shartidan kafolatlanmaydi
options.C: Chunki agar $Ax = 0$, $x \neq 0$ boʻlsa, u holda $x = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — zidlik kelib chiqadi
options.D: Chunki determinant nolga teng boʻlib qoladi, bu $A$ ni degeneratsiyalangan qiladi

uz.explanation: Agar $Ax = 0$, $x \neq 0$ va $A$ ning teskari matritsasi boʻlsa, u holda $x = A^{-1}Ax = A^{-1}0 = 0$ — zidlik. «Proobraz muammosi» faqat akslantirish oʻzaro bir-qiymatli boʻlganda boʻlmaydi; null-vektor esa aksincha, bunday emasligini isbotlaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: If $A$ and $C$ are invertible $3 \times 3$ matrices, is $A + C$ invertible? Is $AC$? Is $A^{-1}C$?
shuffledQuestions.optionC: $A + C$: not necessarily, $AC$: not necessarily, $A^{-1}C$: always
shuffledQuestions.explanation: $A + C$ is not necessarily invertible (e.g., $C = -A$ gives $0$), but $AC$ and $A^{-1}C$ are always invertible as products of invertible matrices.

ru.text: Если $A$ и $C$ — обратимые матрицы $3 \times 3$, обратима ли $A + C$? А $AC$? А $A^{-1}C$?

options.C: $A + C$: не обязательно, $AC$: не обязательно, $A^{-1}C$: всегда

ru.explanation: $A + C$ не обязательно обратима (например, $C = -A$ даёт $0$), но $AC$ и $A^{-1}C$ всегда обратимы как произведения обратимых матриц.

uz.text: Agar $A$ va $C$ teskari $3 \times 3$ matritsalar boʻlsa, $A + C$ teskari matritsaga egami? $AC$-chi? $A^{-1}C$-chi?

options.A: $A + C$: har doim, $AC$: har doim, $A^{-1}C$: har doim
options.B: $A + C$: hech qachon, $AC$: har doim, $A^{-1}C$: har doim
options.C: $A + C$: har doim ham emas, $AC$: har doim ham emas, $A^{-1}C$: har doim
options.D: $A + C$: har doim ham emas, $AC$: har doim, $A^{-1}C$: har doim

uz.explanation: $A + C$ har doim ham teskari matritsaga ega emas (masalan, $C = -A$ boʻlsa $0$ chiqadi), lekin $AC$ va $A^{-1}C$ teskari matritsalar koʻpaytmasi boʻlgani uchun har doim teskari matritsaga ega.

shuffledQuestions.text: Carry out Gauss–Jordan elimination for $A = \begin{pmatrix}4&-6&0\\-2&7&2\end{pmatrix}$ and state $A^{-1}$.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Gauss-Jordan elimination yields $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}12/8&-5/8&-6/8\\8/8&-3/8&-2/8\\-1&1&-1/8\end{pmatrix}$. The determinant is $-16$, confirming the inverse calculation.

ru.text: Выполните исключение Гаусса–Жордана для $A = \begin{pmatrix}4&-6&0\\-2&7&2\end{pmatrix}$ и укажите $A^{-1}$.
ru.explanation: Исключение Гаусса–Жордана даёт $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}12/8&-5/8&-6/8\\8/8&-3/8&-2/8\\-1&1&-1/8\end{pmatrix}$. Определитель равен $-16$, что подтверждает вычисление обратной матрицы.

uz.text: $A = \begin{pmatrix}4&-6&0\\-2&7&2\end{pmatrix}$ uchun Gauss–Jordan usulini bajaring va $A^{-1}$ ni koʻrsating.
uz.explanation: Gauss–Jordan usuli $A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix}12/8&-5/8&-6/8\\8/8&-3/8&-2/8\\-1&1&-1/8\end{pmatrix}$ ni beradi. Determinant $-16$ ga teng, bu teskari matritsa hisobini tasdiqlaydi.

shuffledQuestions.text: State the determinant-transpose identities: $det(A^T)$, $det(AB)$, $det(A^{-1})$.
shuffledQuestions.explanation: The identities are $det(A^T) = det(A)$, $det(AB) = det(A)det(B)$, and $det(A^{-1}) = \frac{1}{det(A)}$, which shows $A$ is invertible iff $det(A) \neq 0$.

ru.text: Сформулируйте тождества определителя и транспонирования: $det(A^T)$, $det(AB)$, $det(A^{-1})$.
ru.explanation: Тождества: $det(A^T) = det(A)$, $det(AB) = det(A)det(B)$ и $det(A^{-1}) = \frac{1}{det(A)}$; они показывают, что $A$ обратима тогда и только тогда, когда $det(A) \neq 0$.

uz.text: Determinant–transponirlash ayniyatlarini yozing: $det(A^T)$, $det(AB)$, $det(A^{-1})$.
uz.explanation: Ayniyatlar: $det(A^T) = det(A)$, $det(AB) = det(A)det(B)$ va $det(A^{-1}) = \frac{1}{det(A)}$; ular $A$ faqat $det(A) \neq 0$ boʻlganda teskari matritsaga ega ekanligini koʻrsatadi.

shuffledQuestions.text: Prove $(A^{-1})^T = (A^T)^{-1}$ and explain why $A^T A$ is symmetric with nonnegative diagonal.
shuffledQuestions.optionA: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = A$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki} \geq 0$
shuffledQuestions.optionB: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A A^T$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
shuffledQuestions.optionC: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
shuffledQuestions.optionD: $(A^{-1})^T$ is inverse of $A^T$ because $(A^{-1})^T A^T = -I$; $A^T A$ is symmetric as $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, with diagonal entries $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
shuffledQuestions.explanation: Transposing $AA^{-1} = I$ gives $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$, proving $(A^{-1})^T$ is the inverse of $A^T$. $A^T A$ is symmetric since $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, and its diagonal entries are sums of squares, hence nonnegative.

ru.text: Докажите $(A^{-1})^T = (A^T)^{-1}$ и объясните, почему $A^T A$ симметрична и имеет неотрицательную диагональ.

options.A: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = A$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki} \geq 0$
options.B: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A A^T$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.C: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.D: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная для $A^T$, потому что $(A^{-1})^T A^T = -I$; $A^T A$ симметрична, так как $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, диагональные элементы $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$

ru.explanation: Транспонируя $AA^{-1} = I$, получаем $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$, что доказывает: $(A^{-1})^T$ — обратная матрица для $A^T$. $A^T A$ симметрична, поскольку $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, а её диагональные элементы — суммы квадратов, следовательно, неотрицательны.

uz.text: $(A^{-1})^T = (A^T)^{-1}$ ekanligini isbotlang va $A^T A$ nima uchun simmetrik hamda manfiy boʻlmagan diagonalga ega ekanligini tushuntiring.

options.A: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = A$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki} \geq 0$
options.B: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A A^T$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.C: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$
options.D: $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi, chunki $(A^{-1})^T A^T = -I$; $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, diagonal elementlari $a_{ki}^2 \geq 0$

uz.explanation: $AA^{-1} = I$ ni transponirlasak, $(A^{-1})^T A^T = I$ boʻladi; bu $(A^{-1})^T$ — $A^T$ ning teskari matritsasi ekanligini isbotlaydi. $A^T A$ simmetrik, chunki $(A^T A)^T = A^T A$, uning diagonal elementlari kvadratlar yigʻindisi boʻlgani uchun manfiy emas.

test.title: English for Engineering I — Weeks 1-4: Complete Test · F
test.description: All four weeks in one test: Week 1 Present Simple & "Getting to know you" + TED "Stereotypes"; Week 2 Present Simple vs Continuous, Articles & Business Grammar; Week 3 Quantifiers, Numbers & Digital Life; Week 4 Prepositions of movement, "The power of numbers" & Test 1 prep. The full study-guide PDF and all course audio/video players are attached to the test.

questions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you from?"
questions.explanation: The verb be with you → are: "Where are you from?" (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Откуда ты ___?»
ru.explanation: Глагол be с you → are: “Where are you from?” (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerdan ___?»
uz.explanation: you bilan be feʼli → are: “Where are you from?” (berilgan savol).

questions.text: Getting to know you: "Where ___ you born?"
questions.explanation: "Where were you born?" — passive past of be with you → were (given question).

ru.text: Знакомство: «Где ты ___?»
ru.explanation: “Where were you born?” — страдательный залог в прошедшем времени от be с you → were (данный вопрос).

uz.text: Tanishuv: «Sen qayerda ___?»
uz.explanation: “Where were you born?” — be feʼlining you bilan oʻtgan zamondagi majhul shakli → were (berilgan savol).

questions.text: What languages do you ___?
questions.explanation: speak a language; "say/tell" take different objects, "talk" needs "about/of".

ru.text: Какими языками ты ___?
ru.explanation: speak a language (говорить на языке); “say/tell” требуют других дополнений, “talk” требует “about/of”.

uz.text: Sen qaysi tillarda ___?
uz.explanation: speak a language (til gapirish); “say/tell” boshqa toʻldiruvchilar bilan ishlatiladi, “talk” uchun esa “about/of” kerak.

questions.text: Where do you ___? (= where are you a student / do you work?)
questions.explanation: Key: live (also possible: study). "Where do you live?" is the standard question.

ru.text: Где ты ___? (= где ты учишься / работаешь?)
ru.explanation: Ключ: live (возможен также: study). “Where do you live?” — стандартный вопрос.

uz.text: Sen qayerda ___? (= qayerda oʻqiysan yoki ishlaysan?)
uz.explanation: Kalit: live (yana mumkin: study). “Where do you live?” — standart savol.

questions.text: Do you ___ any brothers or sisters?
questions.explanation: Do + you + infinitive have: "Do you have any brothers or sisters?"

ru.text: У тебя ___ братья или сёстры?
ru.explanation: Do + you + инфинитив have: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?”

uz.text: Senda aka-uka yoki opa-singillar ___?
uz.explanation: Do + you + have feʼlining asosiy shakli: “Do you have any brothers or sisters?”

questions.text: Do you ___ any pets?
questions.explanation: Key: have — "Do you have any pets?" (present simple question with do).

ru.text: У тебя ___ домашние животные?
ru.explanation: Ключ: have — “Do you have any pets?” (вопрос в present simple с do).

uz.text: Senda uy hayvonlari ___?
uz.explanation: Kalit: have — “Do you have any pets?” (do bilan present simple savoli).

questions.text: What do you ___? (= what is your job or study?)
questions.explanation: The fixed question "What do you do?" asks about job/study.

ru.text: Чем ты ___? (= какая у тебя работа или учёба?)
ru.explanation: Устойчивый вопрос “What do you do?” спрашивает о работе/учёбе.

uz.text: Sen nima ___? (= ishing yoki oʻqishing nima?)
uz.explanation: “What do you do?” — ish yoki oʻqish haqida soʻraydigan barqaror savol.

questions.text: What time do you ___ up during the week?
questions.explanation: get up = leave your bed. Key: get.

ru.text: Во сколько ты ___ в будние дни?
ru.explanation: get up = вставать с кровати. Ключ: get.

uz.text: Hafta davomida soat nechada ___?
uz.explanation: get up = yotoqdan turish. Kalit: get.

questions.text: What do you usually ___ lunch?
questions.explanation: have lunch (also eat). Key: have.

ru.text: Что ты обычно ___ на обед?
ru.explanation: have lunch (также: eat). Ключ: have.

uz.text: Odatda tushlikka nima ___?
uz.explanation: have lunch (yana: eat). Kalit: have.

questions.text: What do you usually ___ in the evening?
questions.explanation: "What do you do in the evening?" — general activity verb do.

ru.text: Что ты обычно ___ вечером?
ru.explanation: “What do you do in the evening?” — do как общий глагол действия.

uz.text: Kechqurun odatda nima ___?
uz.explanation: “What do you do in the evening?” — umumiy harakat feʼli do.

questions.text: What time do you usually ___ to bed?
questions.explanation: go to bed is the fixed expression.

ru.text: Во сколько ты обычно ___ спать?
ru.explanation: go to bed — устойчивое выражение.

uz.text: Odatda soat nechada uxlashga ___?
uz.explanation: go to bed — barqaror ibora.

questions.text: Where did you ___ English before?
questions.explanation: did + you + infinitive: study (also: learn). Key: study.

ru.text: Где ты раньше ___ английский?
ru.explanation: did + you + инфинитив: study (также: learn). Ключ: study.

uz.text: Ilgari ingliz tilini qayerda ___?
uz.explanation: did + you + asosiy shakl (infinitiv): study (yana: learn). Kalit: study.

questions.text: What kind of music do you ___ to?
questions.explanation: listen TO music; "hear" is not used with to.

ru.text: Какую музыку ты ___?
ru.explanation: listen TO music (слушать музыку); “hear” с to не употребляется.

uz.text: Qanday musiqani ___?
uz.explanation: listen TO music; “hear” feʼli to bilan ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: What TV programmes or series do you ___?
questions.explanation: watch TV programmes — the standard collocation.

ru.text: Какие телепередачи или сериалы ты ___?
ru.explanation: watch TV programmes — стандартное словосочетание.

uz.text: Qanday telekoʻrsatuv yoki seriallarni ___?
uz.explanation: watch TV programmes — standart birikma.

questions.text: Do you ___ any sport or exercise?
questions.explanation: do sport / do exercise (also: play + game). Key: do.

ru.text: Ты ___ каким-нибудь спортом или упражнениями?
ru.explanation: do sport / do exercise (также: play + game). Ключ: do.

uz.text: Sen biror sport yoki mashq bilan ___?
uz.explanation: do sport / do exercise (yana: play + game). Kalit: do.

questions.text: What kind of books or magazines do you ___?
questions.explanation: read books/magazines.

ru.text: Какие книги или журналы ты ___?
ru.explanation: read books/magazines (читать книги/журналы).

uz.text: Qanday kitob yoki jurnallarni ___?
uz.explanation: read books/magazines (kitob/jurnal oʻqish).

questions.text: How often do you ___ to the cinema?
questions.explanation: go to the cinema — fixed expression.

ru.text: Как часто ты ___ в кино?
ru.explanation: go to the cinema — устойчивое выражение.

uz.text: Qanchalik tez kinoga ___?
uz.explanation: go to the cinema — barqaror ibora.

questions.text: What did you ___ last weekend?
questions.explanation: did + infinitive: "What did you do last weekend?"

ru.text: Что ты ___ в прошлые выходные?
ru.explanation: did + инфинитив: “What did you do last weekend?”

uz.text: Oʻtgan dam olish kunlari nima ___?
uz.explanation: did + asosiy shakl: “What did you do last weekend?”

questions.text: (?) Anna / like music — Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: does + subject + infinitive (Rule 2): "Does Anna like music?"

ru.text: (?) Anna / like music — Выберите правильный вопрос.
ru.explanation: does + подлежащее + инфинитив (Правило 2): “Does Anna like music?”

uz.text: (?) Anna / like music — Toʻgʻri savolni tanlang.
uz.explanation: does + ega + asosiy shakl (2-qoida): “Does Anna like music?”

questions.text: (+) my sister / have a lot of hobbies — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: My sister is have a lot of hobbies.
questions.optionB: My sister haves a lot of hobbies.
questions.optionC: My sister have a lot of hobbies.
questions.optionD: My sister has a lot of hobbies.
questions.explanation: have → has after she (Rule 3).

ru.text: (+) my sister / have a lot of hobbies — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: have → has после she (Правило 3).

uz.text: (+) my sister / have a lot of hobbies — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: she dan keyin have → has boʻladi (3-qoida).

questions.text: (−) I / get on very well with my parents — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: I doesn't get on very well with my parents.
questions.optionB: I don't get on very well with my parents.
questions.optionC: I not get on very well with my parents.
questions.optionD: I don't gets on very well with my parents.
questions.explanation: don't + infinitive for I.

ru.text: (−) I / get on very well with my parents — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: don't + инфинитив для I.

uz.text: (−) I / get on very well with my parents — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: I uchun don't + asosiy shakl.

questions.text: (+) my nephew / study English at university — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: My nephew study English at university.
questions.optionB: My nephew studies English at university.
questions.optionC: My nephew studys English at university.
questions.optionD: My nephew is study English at university.
questions.explanation: consonant + y → -ies: studies (Rule 3).

ru.text: (+) my nephew / study English at university — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: согласная + y → -ies: studies (Правило 3).

uz.text: (+) my nephew / study English at university — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: undosh + y → -ies: studies (3-qoida).

questions.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: My neighbours doesn't have any children.
questions.optionB: My neighbours not have any children.
questions.optionC: My neighbours aren't have any children.
questions.optionD: My neighbours don't have any children.
questions.explanation: don't have any — plural subject, any in negatives.

ru.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: don't have any — подлежащее во множественном числе, any в отрицаниях.

uz.text: (−) my neighbours / have any children — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: don't have any — koʻplikdagi ega, inkor gapda any.

questions.text: (?) what time / the film start — Choose the correct question.
questions.optionA: What time does the film start?
questions.optionB: What time does the film starts?
questions.optionC: What time do the film start?
questions.explanation: does + the film + start (Rule 2).

ru.text: (?) what time / the film start — Выберите правильный вопрос.
ru.explanation: does + the film + start (Правило 2).

uz.text: (?) what time / the film start — Toʻgʻri savolni tanlang.
uz.explanation: does + the film + start (2-qoida).

questions.text: (+) he / go out twice a week — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: He is go out twice a week.
questions.optionB: He go out twice a week.
questions.optionC: He goes out twice a week.
questions.optionD: He gos out twice a week.
questions.explanation: go → goes (Rule 3); frequency expression at the end (Rule 6).

ru.text: (+) he / go out twice a week — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: go → goes (Правило 3); выражение частотности в конце (Правило 6).

uz.text: (+) he / go out twice a week — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.

questions.text: (−) we / often talk about politics — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: We don't often talk about politics.
questions.optionB: We don't talk often about politics.
questions.optionC: We often don't talk about politics.
questions.optionD: We often talk not about politics.
questions.explanation: the adverb goes after don't, before the main verb (Rule 5).

ru.text: (−) we / often talk about politics — Выберите правильное предложение.

uz.text: (−) we / often talk about politics — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: ravish don't dan keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi (5-qoida).

questions.text: (?) how often / you see your brother — Choose the correct question.

questions.optionB: How often does you see your brother?
questions.optionC: How often are you see your brother?
questions.optionD: How often do you see your brother?

ru.text: (?) how often / you see your brother — Выберите правильный вопрос.
ru.explanation: do + you + see.

uz.text: (?) how often / you see your brother — Toʻgʻri savolni tanlang.
uz.explanation: do + you + see.

questions.text: (−) Sally / go on social media very much — Choose the correct sentence.
questions.optionA: Sally doesn't go on social media very much.
questions.optionB: Sally don't go on social media very much.
questions.optionC: Sally isn't go on social media very much.
questions.optionD: Sally doesn't goes on social media very much.

ru.text: (−) Sally / go on social media very much — Выберите правильное предложение.
ru.explanation: doesn't + go (показатель 3-го лица -s у вспомогательного глагола).

uz.text: (−) Sally / go on social media very much — Toʻgʻri gapni tanlang.
uz.explanation: doesn't + go (-s qoʻshimchasi yordamchi feʼlga qoʻshiladi, 3-shaxs).

questions.text: always / before / go / I / bed / 11.00 / to — Choose the correct order.

questions.optionC: I always go to bed before 11.00.
questions.optionD: I go to bed always before 11.00.

ru.text: always / before / go / I / bed / 11.00 / to — Выберите правильный порядок.

uz.text: ever / her / Kate / sees / family / hardly — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.

questions.text: Saturdays / never / shopping / on / go / we — Choose the correct order.

uz.text: Saturdays / never / shopping / on / go / we — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.

uz.text: a / to / I / dentist’s / year / go / twice / the — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.

uz.text: in / they / breakfast / sometimes / bed / have — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.

ru.text: often / late / Laila / is / work / for — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: Наречие ПОСЛЕ глагола be (Правило 5).

uz.text: often / late / Laila / is / work / for — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Ravish be feʼlidan KEYIN keladi (5-qoida).

questions.text: often / Ivan / to / go / doesn’t / theatre / the — Choose the correct order.
questions.optionA: Ivan often go doesn't to the theatre.
questions.optionB: Ivan doesn't go often to the theatre.
questions.optionC: Ivan often doesn't go to the theatre.
questions.optionD: Ivan doesn't often go to the theatre.
questions.explanation: adverb after doesn't, before the main verb (Rule 5).

ru.text: often / Ivan / to / go / doesn’t / theatre / the — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: наречие после doesn't, перед смысловым глаголом (Правило 5).

uz.text: often / Ivan / to / go / doesn’t / theatre / the — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.
uz.explanation: ravish doesn't dan keyin, asosiy feʼldan oldin (5-qoida).

questions.text: visit / I / once / my / month / a / mum — Choose the correct order.
questions.optionA: Once a month visit I my mum.
questions.optionB: I once a month visit my mum.
questions.optionC: I visit my mum once a month.
questions.optionD: I visit my mum a once month.
questions.explanation: Frequency expression at the end (Rule 6).

ru.text: visit / I / once / my / month / a / mum — Выберите правильный порядок.
ru.explanation: Выражение частотности в конце (Правило 6).

uz.text: visit / I / once / my / month / a / mum — Toʻgʻri tartibni tanlang.
uz.explanation: Chastota iborasi oxirida (6-qoida).

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:01–0:27): What did people tell Olivia about French people — and what did she discover?
questions.optionA: People said France was just like her home country.
questions.optionB: People warned her the French were rude and unfriendly, but she found them kind and welcoming — the stereotype was wrong.
questions.optionC: People said the French were very friendly, but she found them rude.
questions.optionD: People told her nothing about the French before her trip.
questions.explanation: Before the trip people warned her; on arrival she discovered the opposite — a classic wrong stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Что люди рассказывали Olivia о французах — и что она обнаружила?
ru.explanation: До поездки люди предупреждали её; по прибытии она обнаружила обратное — классический ошибочный стереотип.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:01–0:27): Odamlar Oliviyaga fransuzlar haqida nima dedilar — va u nimani aniqladi?
uz.explanation: Sayohatdan oldin odamlar uni ogohlantirgan; yetib kelgach esa aksini koʻrgan — notoʻgʻri stereotipning klassik namunasi.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (0:57–1:09): What happened after Olivia won a point in a sport?
questions.optionA: A boy congratulated her and asked her to join the team.
questions.optionB: Her coach said she should practise more.
questions.optionD: A boy told her "you play like a girl" — meant as an insult, and it made her feel hurt, small and angry.
questions.explanation: The comment "you play like a girl" treats being a girl as something bad — a gender stereotype.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:57–1:09): Что случилось после того, как Olivia выиграла очко в спорте?
ru.explanation: Реплика “you play like a girl” подаёт «быть девочкой» как нечто плохое — гендерный стереотип.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (0:57–1:09): Olivia sportda ochko yutgandan keyin nima boʻldi?
uz.explanation: “you play like a girl” degan gap qiz boʻlishni yomon narsa kabi koʻrsatadi — gender stereotipi.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (2:22): Which two phrases does Olivia mention as harmful?
questions.optionA: "you play like a girl" and "that's not very ladylike"
questions.optionB: "you are so tall" and "you are so kind"
questions.explanation: Both phrases box children (especially girls) into gender stereotypes.

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (2:22): Какие две фразы Olivia называет вредными?
ru.explanation: Обе фразы загоняют детей (особенно девочек) в гендерные стереотипы.

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (2:22): Olivia qaysi ikki iborani zararli deb ataydi?
uz.explanation: Har ikkala ibora bolalarni (ayniqsa qizlarni) gender stereotiplariga siqib joylaydi.

questions.text: TED "Stereotypes" (3:15): What are Olivia's three steps to stop contributing to stereotypes?
questions.optionA: Read more books; watch less TV; do more sport.
questions.optionB: Ignore stereotypes; change the subject; stay silent.
questions.optionC: Call out stereotypes; check your own assumptions; be the example.
questions.optionD: Argue with everyone; write complaints; leave the room.
questions.explanation: Her closing message: "You have to be the change you wish to see."

ru.text: TED «Stereotypes» (3:15): Каковы три шага Olivia, чтобы перестать поддерживать стереотипы?
ru.explanation: Её финальный призыв: “You have to be the change you wish to see.”

uz.text: TED «Stereotypes» (3:15): Olivia stereotiplarga hissa qoʻshishni toʻxtatish uchun qanday uch qadamni aytadi?
uz.explanation: Uning yakuniy murojaati: “You have to be the change you wish to see.”

questions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…" — choose the complete correct phrase pair.
questions.optionA: Personally, I am not thinking people should need a driving licence
questions.optionB: Personally, I don't think people should need a driving licence
questions.optionC: Personal, I don't think people should needing a driving licence
questions.optionD: In person, I don't think people shall need a driving licence
questions.explanation: The box trains Personally / should need: opinion adverb + should + infinitive (Rule 7).

ru.text: Выражение своего мнения (3.13): «___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…» — выберите полную правильную пару фраз.
ru.explanation: Упражнение отрабатывает Personally / should need: наречие мнения + should + инфинитив (Правило 7).

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «___, I don't think people ___ ___ a driving licence…» — toʻliq toʻgʻri iboralar juftligini tanlang.
uz.explanation: Mashq Personally / should need ni mustahkamlaydi: fikr ravishi + should + asosiy shakl (7-qoida).

questions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "In ___, e-scooters are dangerous." — choose the correct phrase.
questions.optionB: In my view of e-scooters are dangerous.
questions.optionC: In my opinionate, e-scooters are dangerous.
questions.optionD: In my opinion, e-scooters are dangerous.
questions.explanation: Key: In my opinion / In my view — fixed phrases for opinions.

ru.text: Выражение своего мнения (3.13): «In ___, e-scooters are dangerous.» — выберите правильную фразу.
ru.explanation: Ключ: In my opinion / In my view — устойчивые фразы для выражения мнения.

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «In ___, e-scooters are dangerous.» — toʻgʻri iborani tanlang.
uz.explanation: Kalit: In my opinion / In my view — fikr bildirishning barqaror iboralari.

questions.text: Giving your opinion (3.13): "But I think people ___ to ride them." — choose the correct completion.
questions.optionA: should have to pass a test to ride them
questions.optionB: are should passing a test to ride them
questions.optionC: have should pass a test to ride them
questions.optionD: should to pass a test to ride them
questions.explanation: should + have to + infinitive: "people should have to pass a test" (Rule 7).

ru.text: Выражение своего мнения (3.13): «But I think people ___ to ride them.» — выберите правильное завершение.
ru.explanation: should + have to + инфинитив: “people should have to pass a test” (Правило 7).

uz.text: Fikr bildirish (3.13): «But I think people ___ to ride them.» — toʻgʻri yakunni tanlang.
uz.explanation: should + have to + asosiy shakl: “people should have to pass a test” (7-qoida).

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": Generalizing is useful because it helps us to…
questions.explanation: Generalizations are based on facts and evidence and help us understand the world → C.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Обобщение полезно, потому что помогает нам…
ru.explanation: Обобщения основаны на фактах и доказательствах и помогают нам понимать окружающий мир → C.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Umumlashtirish foydali, chunki u bizga… yordam beradi.
uz.explanation: Umumlashtirishlar fakt va dalillarga asoslanadi va bizga atrofdagi dunyoni tushunishga yordam beradi → C.

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": Stereotyping is a problem because it is based on…
questions.explanation: A stereotype "can come from ideas about these groups, not truths" → B.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Стереотипизация — проблема, потому что она основана на…
ru.explanation: Стереотип “can come from ideas about these groups, not truths” — возникает из представлений об этих группах, а не из истин → B.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Stereotiplash muammo, chunki u …ga asoslangan.
uz.explanation: Stereotip “can come from ideas about these groups, not truths” — bu guruhlar haqidagi tasavvurlardan kelib chiqadi, haqiqatlardan emas → B.

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": It's wrong to make assumptions about people based on things like…
questions.explanation: The article calls appearance- and gender-based assumptions inappropriate → D.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Неправильно делать предположения о людях на основе таких вещей, как…
ru.explanation: В статье предположения на основе внешности и гендера названы неуместными → D.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Odamlar haqida … kabi narsalar asosida taxmin yuritish notoʻgʻri.
uz.explanation: Maqolada tashqi koʻrinish va jinsga asoslangan taxminlar maʼqulsiz deb ataladi → D.

questions.text: Reading "Generalize, but don't stereotype!": Generalizing is neutral, but…
questions.explanation: Generalizing is neutral; stereotyping is a harmful, often negative generalization → A.

ru.text: Текст «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Обобщение нейтрально, но…
ru.explanation: Обобщение нейтрально; стереотипизация — вредное, часто негативное обобщение → A.

uz.text: Matn «Generalize, but don't stereotype!»: Umumlashtirish neytral, lekin…
uz.explanation: Umumlashtirish neytral; stereotiplash esa zararli, koʻpincha salbiy umumlashtirish → A.

questions.text: Complete the quote (Santayana): "___ child educated only at ___ school is ___ uneducated child."
questions.explanation: First mention a child; "at school" uncountably (zero article); an before a vowel sound.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Santayana): «___ ребёнок, получивший образование только в ___ школе, — это ___ невоспитанный ребёнок.»
ru.explanation: Первое упоминание — a child; “at school” — без артикля (нулевой); an — перед гласным звуком.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Santayana): «___ bola faqat ___ maktabda taʼlim olgan boʻlsa, u ___ taʼlimsiz boladir.»
uz.explanation: Birinchi tilga olishda — a child; “at school” — artiklsiz (nol artikl); an — unli tovushdan oldin.

questions.text: Complete the quote (Carlyle): "___ greatest university of all is ___ collection of ___ books."
questions.explanation: Superlative → the; a collection; general plural books (zero article).

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Carlyle): «___ величайший из всех университетов — это ___ собрание ___ книг.»
ru.explanation: Превосходная степень → the; a collection; общее множественное books (нулевой артикль).

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Carlyle): «Barcha davrlarning ___ eng buyuk universiteti — bu ___ toʻplam ___ kitobdir.»
uz.explanation: Superlativ → the; a collection; umumiy koʻplik books (nol artikl).

questions.text: Complete the quote (Malala): "___ extremists have shown what frightens them ___ most: ___ girl with ___ book."
questions.explanation: General plural (zero); superlative adverb "most" with zero article; two first mentions a girl / a book.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Malala): «___ экстремисты показали, чего они боятся ___ больше всего: ___ девочка с ___ книгой.»
ru.explanation: Общее множественное (нулевой); превосходное наречие “most” без артикля; два первых упоминания — a girl / a book.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Malala): «___ ekstremistlar ularni ___ eng koʻp qoʻrqitadigan narsani koʻrsatdilar: ___ qiz bilan ___ kitob.»
uz.explanation: Umumiy koʻplik (nol); superlativ ravish “most” artiklsiz; ikkita birinchi tilga olish — a girl / a book.

questions.text: Complete the quote (Sotomayor): "Until we get ___ equality in ___ education we will not be ___ equal society."
questions.explanation: Uncountable abstract nouns take zero article; an + adjective (equal) + singular noun.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Sotomayor): «Пока мы не добьёмся ___ равенства в ___ образовании, мы не будем ___ равноправным обществом.»
ru.explanation: Несчётные абстрактные существительные — нулевой артикль; an + прилагательное (equal) + существительное в единственном числе.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Sotomayor): «___ tenglikni ___ taʼlimda qoʻlga kiritmagunimizcha, biz ___ teng jamiyat boʻlmaymiz.»
uz.explanation: Sanalmaydigan abstrakt otlar artiklsiz (nol artikl); an + sifat (equal) + birlikdagi ot.

questions.text: Complete the quote (Frost): "Having one child makes you ___ parent. Having two, you are ___ referee."
questions.explanation: a member of a class: a parent, a referee.

ru.text: Дополните цитату (Frost): «Один ребёнок делает тебя ___ родителем. Когда детей двое, ты — ___ судья.»
ru.explanation: a — отнесение к классу: a parent, a referee.

uz.text: Iqtibosni toʻldiring (Frost): «Bitta bola seni ___ ota-onaga aylantiradi. Ikkitasi boʻlsa, sen ___ hakamsan.»
uz.explanation: a — sinfga mansublikni bildiradi: a parent, a referee.

questions.text: Ariana is ___ in a hospital. ___ is a long way from her house.
questions.explanation: a nurse = a member of a class; The hospital = the specific one already known.

ru.text: Ариана — ___ в больнице. ___ находится далеко от её дома.
ru.explanation: a nurse — представитель класса (профессия); The hospital — конкретная, уже известная больница.

uz.text: Ariana kasalxonada ___. ___ uning uyidan uzoqda joylashgan.
uz.explanation: a nurse — sinf vakili (kasb); The hospital — maʼlum, aniq kasalxona.

questions.text: What ___! We'll have to eat our picnic in ___.
questions.explanation: Exclamation What a…!; the specific car they arrived in.

ru.text: Как ___! Придётся съесть наш пикник в ___.
ru.explanation: Восклицание What a…!; конкретная машина, в которой они приехали.

uz.text: Qanday ___! Piknikimizni ___ yeyishimizga toʻgʻri keladi.
uz.explanation: Undov gap What a…!; ular kelgan aniq mashina.

questions.text: My wife and I like ___, but our children prefer ___.
questions.optionA: the love stories; the war films
questions.explanation: General plural = zero article.

ru.text: Мы с женой любим ___, но наши дети предпочитают ___.
ru.explanation: Общее множественное число — нулевой артикль.

uz.text: Men va rafiqam ___ yaxshi koʻramiz, lekin farzandlarimiz ___ afzal koʻradi.
uz.explanation: Umumiy koʻplik — nol artikl.

questions.text: We go to ___ about ___.
questions.explanation: the theatre = place in a town; a in frequency expressions (once a month).

ru.text: Мы ходим в ___ примерно ___.
ru.explanation: the theatre — место в городе; a в выражениях частотности (once a month).

uz.text: Biz ___ ga taxminan ___ boramiz.
uz.explanation: the theatre — shahardagi joy; chastota iboralarida a (once a month).

questions.text: I'm having ___ with some friends ___.
questions.explanation: Meals take no article; next + day without the.

ru.text: У меня ___ с друзьями ___.
ru.explanation: Названия приёмов пищи — без артикля; next + день — без the.

uz.text: Men baʼzi doʻstlarim bilan ___ ni ___ oʻtkazaman.
uz.explanation: Ovqat nomlari artiklsiz; next + kun oldidan the kelmaydi.

questions.text: My boyfriend is ___. I think he's ___ in the world.
questions.explanation: Profession → a; superlative → the.

ru.text: Мой парень — ___. Думаю, он ___ в мире.
ru.explanation: Профессия → a; превосходная степень → the.

uz.text: Mening yigʻitim — ___. Menimcha, u dunyoda ___.
uz.explanation: Kasb → a; superlativ → the.

questions.text: I'm not sure if I closed ___ before I left ___ this morning.
questions.explanation: The specific windows of the house; fixed expression left home.

ru.text: Не уверен, закрыл ли я ___ перед тем, как уйти из ___ сегодня утром.
ru.explanation: Конкретные окна этого дома; устойчивое выражение left home (без артикля).

uz.text: Bugun ertalab ___ dan chiqishdan oldin ___ ni yopdim-yoʻqmidi, ishonchim komil emas.
uz.explanation: Uyning aniq oynalari; left home — birikma (artiklsiz).

questions.text: In general, I like ___, but I don't like ___ that live next door to me.
questions.explanation: General plural vs. the dogs defined by the relative clause.

ru.text: В целом я люблю ___, но мне не нравятся ___, которые живут по соседству со мной.
ru.explanation: Общее множественное против the + dogs, определённых придаточным предложением.

uz.text: Umuman olganda, men ___ ni yaxshi koʻraman, lekin menga qoʻshnimizda yashovchi ___ yoqmaydi.
uz.explanation: Umumiy koʻplik bilan nisbiy gap bilan aniqlangan the dogs oʻrtasidagi farq.

questions.text: I got to ___ late every day ___.
questions.explanation: School as an institution after get to; last + week.

ru.text: Каждый день я опаздывал в ___ ___.
ru.explanation: School как учреждение после get to; last + week (без артикля).

uz.text: Har kuni ___ ga kech qolardim ___.
uz.explanation: get to dan keyin school — muassasa sifatida; last + week (artiklsiz).

questions.text: I think ___ is more important than ___.
questions.explanation: Uncountable abstract nouns in general statements take zero article.

ru.text: Я думаю, ___ важнее, чем ___.
ru.explanation: Несчётные абстрактные существительные в общих высказываниях — без артикля.

uz.text: Menimcha, ___ ___ dan muhimroq.
uz.explanation: Umumiy bayonlarda sanalmaydigan abstrakt otlar artiklsiz.

questions.text: "How often do you go to ___ gym?" — "About three times ___ week. But I never go on ___ Fridays."
questions.explanation: the gym (place in town); a week (frequency); zero before days (Fridays).

ru.text: «Как часто ты ходишь в ___ спортзал?» — «Около трёх раз ___ неделю. Но по ___ пятницам я никогда не хожу.»
ru.explanation: the gym (место в городе); a week (частотность); нулевой артикль перед днями (Fridays).

uz.text: «Sen ___ sportzalga qanchalik tez-tez borasan?» — «Taxminan uch marta ___ haftada. Lekin ___ juma kunlari umuman bormayman.»
uz.explanation: the gym (shahardagi joy); a week (chastota); kunlar oldidan nol artikl (Fridays).

questions.text: "What time does ___ train leave?" — "In 40 minutes. Can you drop me off at ___ station on your way to ___ work?"
questions.explanation: Both specific (the train, the station); go to work without an article.

ru.text: «Во сколько отходит ___ поезд?» — «Через 40 минут. Можешь высадить меня на ___ станции по пути на ___ работу?»
ru.explanation: Оба конкретные (the train, the station); go to work — без артикля.

uz.text: «___ poyezd soat nechada ketadi?» — «40 daqiqadan keyin. ___ ishga ketayotganda yoʻlda menga ___ bekatda tushirib qoʻysang boʻladimi?»
uz.explanation: Ikkalasi ham aniq (the train, the station); go to work artiklsiz.

questions.text: "What ___ amazing dress!" — "Thanks. I bought it in ___ sales ___ last month."
questions.explanation: What an…! (vowel); the sales (known); zero before last + month.

ru.text: «Какое ___ потрясающее платье!» — «Спасибо. Я купила его на ___ распродаже ___ в прошлом месяце.»
ru.explanation: What an…! (перед гласным); the sales (известные распродажи); нулевой артикль перед last + month.

uz.text: «Qanday ___ ajoyib koʻylak!» — «Rahmat. Uni ___ savdolarda sotib oldim, ___ oʻtgan oyda.»
uz.explanation: What an…! (unlidan oldin); the savdolar (maʼlum); last + month oldidan nol artikl.

questions.text: "What's ___ most interesting place to visit in your town?" — "Probably ___ castle. It's ___ oldest building."
questions.explanation: Superlative → the most interesting / the oldest; first mention a castle.

ru.text: «Какое ___ самое интересное место для посещения в твоём городе?» — «Наверное, ___ замок. Это ___ самое старое здание.»
ru.explanation: Превосходная степень → the most interesting / the oldest; первое упоминание — a castle.

uz.text: «Shahringda koʻrish uchun ___ eng qiziqarli joy qaysi?» — «Ehtimol, ___ qalʼa. Bu ___ eng qadimiy bino.»
uz.explanation: Superlativ → the most interesting / the oldest; birinchi tilga olish — a castle.

questions.text: "What shall we do ___ next weekend?" — "Let's invite Toni for ___ lunch. We could eat in ___ garden."
questions.explanation: Zero before next weekend and lunch; our garden = specific → the.

ru.text: «Чем займёмся ___ в следующие выходные?» — «Давай пригласим Тони на ___ обед. Мы могли бы поесть в ___ саду.»
ru.explanation: Нулевой артикль перед next weekend и lunch; наш сад — конкретный → the.

uz.text: «___ dam olish kunlari nima qilamiz?» — «Tonini ___ tushlikka taklif qilaylik. ___ bogʻda yesak boʻladi.»
uz.explanation: next weekend va lunch oldidan nol artikl; bogʻimiz aniq → the.

questions.text: "Do you like ___ cats?" — "Not really. I prefer ___ dogs. I think they're ___ best pets."
questions.explanation: General plurals take zero article; superlative the best pets.

ru.text: «Тебе нравятся ___ кошки?» — «Не очень. Я предпочитаю ___ собак. Думаю, они ___ лучшие домашние животные.»
ru.explanation: Общие множественные — без артикля; превосходная степень the best pets.

uz.text: «Senga ___ mushuklar yoqadimi?» — «Unday emas. Men ___ itlarni afzal koʻraman. Menimcha, ular ___ eng yaxshi uy hayvonlari.»
uz.explanation: Umumiy koʻplik artiklsiz; superlativ the best pets.

questions.text: "Is your mum ___ housewife?" — "No, she's ___ teacher. She's always tired when she finishes ___ work."
questions.explanation: Professions with a/an; finish work without an article.

ru.text: «Твоя мама — ___ домохозяйка?» — «Нет, она ___ учительница. Она всегда устаёт, когда заканчивает ___ работу.»
ru.explanation: Профессии с a/an; finish work — без артикля.

uz.text: «Sening onang ___ uy bekasimi?» — «Yoʻq, u ___. U ___ ishini tugatganda doim charchaydi.»
uz.explanation: Kasblar a/an bilan; finish work artiklsiz.

questions.text: "Have you ever had ___ problem in your relationship?" — "Yes, but we solved ___ problem and we got married."
questions.explanation: First mention → a; second mention (already known) → the.

ru.text: «В ваших отношениях когда-нибудь была ___ проблема?» — «Да, но мы решили ___ проблему и поженились.»
ru.explanation: Первое упоминание → a; повторное (уже известное) → the.

uz.text: «Munosabatlaringizda hech qachon ___ muammo boʻlganmi?» — «Ha, lekin biz ___ muammoni hal qildik va turmush qurduk.»
uz.explanation: Birinchi tilga olish → a; takroriy (allaqachon maʼlum) → the.

questions.text: "When is ___ meeting?" — "They've changed ___ date. It's on ___ Tuesday now."
questions.explanation: A specific known meeting and date → the; zero before days (Tuesday).

ru.text: «Когда ___ встреча?» — «Они перенесли ___ дату. Теперь она на ___ вторник.»
ru.explanation: Конкретные, известные встреча и дата → the; перед днями — нулевой артикль (Tuesday).

uz.text: «___ uchrashuv qachon?» — «Ular ___ sanani oʻzgartirishdi. Endi u ___ seshanba kuni boʻladi.»
uz.explanation: Aniq, maʼlum uchrashuv va sana → the; kunlar oldidan nol artikl (Tuesday).

questions.text: Generalizing (3.19): "___, I think it's true that…" — choose the phrase that fills the gap.
questions.explanation: Key phrase: Generally speaking, I think it's true that…

ru.text: Обобщение (3.19): «___, я думаю, что это правда…» — выберите фразу, заполняющую пропуск.
ru.explanation: Ключевая фраза: Generally speaking, I think it's true that…

uz.text: Umumlashtirish (3.19): «___, menimcha, bu toʻgʻri ekan…» — boʻshliqni toʻldiruvchi iborani tanlang.
uz.explanation: Kalit ibora: Generally speaking, I think it's true that…

questions.text: Generalizing (3.19): "In ___, they behave in a more grown-up way."
questions.explanation: In general — fixed phrase for generalizing.

ru.text: Обобщение (3.19): «В ___ они ведут себя более по-взрослому.»
ru.explanation: In general — устойчивая фраза для обобщения.

uz.text: Umumlashtirish (3.19): «___ da ular oʻzini koʻproq voyaga yetganlardek tutadi.»
uz.explanation: In general — umumlashtirish uchun barqaror ibora.

questions.text: Generalizing (3.19): "___ the whole, I think that only children are more independent…" — choose the preposition.
questions.explanation: On the whole — fixed generalizing phrase.

ru.text: Обобщение (3.19): «___ the whole, я думаю, что единственные дети более самостоятельны…» — выберите предлог.
ru.explanation: On the whole — устойчивая обобщающая фраза.

uz.text: Umumlashtirish (3.19): «___ the whole, menimcha, yolgʻiz farzandlar koʻproq mustaqil boʻladi…» — koʻmakchini tanlang.
uz.explanation: On the whole — barqaror umumlashtiruvchi ibora.

questions.text: Generalizing (3.19): "They ___ to spend a lot of time by themselves." — choose the verb.
questions.explanation: tend + to + infinitive: They tend to spend…

ru.text: Обобщение (3.19): «Они ___ проводить много времени в одиночестве.» — выберите глагол.
ru.explanation: tend + to + инфинитив: They tend to spend…

uz.text: Umumlashtirish (3.19): «Ular koʻp vaqtni yolgʻiz oʻtkazishga ___» — feʼlni tanlang.
uz.explanation: tend + to + infinitiv: They tend to spend…

questions.text: Generalizing (3.19): "They aren't ___ very good at…" — choose the word.
questions.explanation: They aren't always very good at… — key phrase from the box.

ru.text: Обобщение (3.19): «Они не ___ очень хороши в…» — выберите слово.
ru.explanation: They aren't always very good at… — ключевая фраза из рамки.

uz.text: Umumlashtirish (3.19): «Ular ___ juda yaxshi emas…» — soʻzni tanlang.
uz.explanation: They aren't always very good at… — qutidagi kalit ibora.

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "I ___ for a transfer to our London office… It all ___ on whether they have vacancies." (apply / depend)
uz.explanation: Vaqtinchalik davom etayotgan holat → am applying; statik depend → depends.

questions.text: BGP Ex.5: "Their new 'own brand' instant coffee ___ very good, so it ___ more and more popular." (taste / become)
questions.explanation: Stative taste → tastes; slow change → is becoming.

ru.text: BGP Упр.5: "Their new 'own brand' instant coffee ___ very good, so it ___ more and more popular." (taste / become)
ru.explanation: Глагол состояния taste → tastes; постепенное изменение → is becoming.

uz.text: BGP 5-mashq: "Their new 'own brand' instant coffee ___ very good, so it ___ more and more popular." (taste / become)
uz.explanation: Statik taste → tastes; sekin oʻzgarish → is becoming.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "Sam ___ (not live) near me."

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.1: "Sam ___ (not live) near me."

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "Sam ___ (not live) near me."
uz.explanation: Uchinchi shaxs, inkor: doesn't live.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "Sofia ___ (drive) to work."
questions.explanation: Third person -s: drives.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.1: "Sofia ___ (drive) to work."
ru.explanation: Третье лицо, окончание -s: drives.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "Sofia ___ (drive) to work."
uz.explanation: Uchinchi shaxs, -s qoʻshimchasi: drives.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "___ she ___ any other languages?" (speak)
questions.explanation: Question with does + infinitive.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.1: "___ she ___ any other languages?" (speak)
ru.explanation: Вопрос с does + инфинитив.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "___ she ___ any other languages?" (speak)
uz.explanation: does + infinitiv bilan soʻroq gap.

questions.text: Worksheet Ex.1: "I ___ (not like) waking up early."
questions.explanation: I → don't like.

ru.text: Рабочий лист Упр.1: "I ___ (not like) waking up early."
ru.explanation: I → don't like.

uz.text: Ish varagʻi 1-mashq: "I ___ (not like) waking up early."
uz.explanation: I → don't like.
